Inscrições para concurso do Samu em Salvador são prorrogadas

17 de Julho de 2017 | 15h 58

Foto: Reprodução

A Prefeitura de Salvador prorrogou o prazo para a inscrição no processo seletivo simplificado para a contratação temporária em Regime Especial Direito Administrativo (Reda) de médicos para atuar no Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência (Samu). Os candidatos podem se inscrever até às 23h59 do dia 23 de julho (domingo).

As inscrições para o processo seletivo começaram no dia 6 de julho. Ao todo, são 67 vagas, com remuneração de R$ 9 mil reais para um plantão semanal de 24h.

As inscrições devem ser realizadas, exclusivamente, via internet. A taxa custa de R$ 50. A seleção será composta de duas fases: avaliação de títulos, de caráter classificatório e eliminatório; e capacitação inicial (40 horas, seguida de avaliação teórico-prática e entrevista de caráter classificatório e eliminatório).

Os requisitos para se inscrever no processo seletivo são: ensino superior completo em medicina, com registro no Conselho Regional, e possuir 18 anos completos, na data da inscrição e da contratação.

  1. Atingir metas mensais, trimestrais e quotas anuais de vendas.

  14. Habilidade para vender de forma eficaz e profissional, em um ambiente de vendas de alto dinamismo, muitas mudanças e alta competitividade.

  19. Fortes habilidades interpessoais, capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e com espírito integrado a um grande time de vendas.
  20. Esforçar-se para a melhorias constantes; inspirar e motivar os outros.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).

As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology.

Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.

  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).

description:
TRM is on a mission to build a safer financial system for billions of people. We deliver a blockchain intelligence data platform to financial institutions, crypto companies, and governments to fight cryptocurrency fraud and financial crime. We consider our business — and our profit — as a way to move towards our mission sustainably and at scale.

The Data Product team collaborates with an experienced group of data scientists, engineers, and product managers to build highly scalable features that power TRM's products and services. As a Software Engineer on the Data Product team, you will be responsible for designing and building mission-critical data services. These features analyze and provide insights into blockchain transaction activity at petabyte scale, and ultimately work to build a safer financial system for billions of people..

The impact you’ll have here:

  • Build highly scalable features that integrate with dozens of blockchains.
  • Design and architect intricate data models for optimal storage and retrieval to support sub-second latency for querying blockchain data.
  • Collaborate across departments, partnering with data scientists, backend engineers, and product managers to design and implement novel data models that enhance TRM’s products.

What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related field.
  • A proven track record, with 5+ years of hands-on experience in architecting scalable API development, distributed system architecture, guiding projects from initial ideation through to successful production deployment.
  • Exceptional programming skills in Python, as well as adeptness in SQL or SparkSQL.
  • Versatility that spans the entire spectrum of data engineering in one or more of the following areas:
    • In-depth experience with data stores such as BigQuery and Postgres.
    • Proficiency in data pipeline and workflow orchestration tools like Airflow and DBT.
    • Expertise in data processing technologies and streaming workflows including Dataflow, Spark, Kafka, and Flink.
    • Competence in deploying and monitoring infrastructure within public cloud platforms, utilizing tools such as Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Datadog.
    • Proven ability in loading, querying, and transforming extensive datasets

About the Team:

  • Our team is spread out over several countries and time zones. To leverage the opportunities and address challenges that come with this working model, we've built a culture grounded in trust, transparency, and adaptability. Even though we're scattered across different time zones, we stay closely connected through open communication and regular check-ins. Our use of digital tools helps us collaborate seamlessly and work at an impressive pace, delivering results at TRM speed while staying in sync.
  • The diversity of perspectives and expertise within our team sparks creative exchanges and enhances our problem-solving capabilities, allowing us to leverage our global synergy to drive innovation and efficiency.
  • We're driven by a deep sense of ownership, constant pursuit of improvement and an obsession with delivering magical experiences to our customers; these are a core part of our culture.
  • We're driven by the desire to continuously hone our craft and to this end, we regularly assess our processes, seek feedback, and embrace iterative development to refine what we do.
  • We structure problems and use the 80/20 rule(for many outcomes, roughly 80% of consequences come from 20% of causes) to identify where to direct our razor-sharp focus.
  • Each of us is passionate about excellence and growth, and we're encouraged to challenge the status quo and experiment with new methods. This mindset creates an environment where innovation is part of our daily routine and every team member is an impact-oriented trailblazer.
  • By celebrating our successes and learning from our setbacks, we stay agile and forward-thinking, always striving to elevate our performance and impact.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • The team received a request from customers to show the running balance for assets tied to an address within the product. They brainstormed to determine the minimal viable solution that could be delivered within two weeks. The team decided to develop a framework that would facilitate enabling this feature for each chain (such as BTC, ETH, etc.) individually. They successfully implemented and tested this solution for the BTC chain and delivered it to customers within the two-week timeframe. This approach allowed the team to quickly provide value to customers and establish a repeatable process.
  • The team was tasked with implementing a new feature that would enable TRM to gather feedback from the user community swiftly. Due to the company's goal of showcasing the feature at an upcoming event, the timeline was tight. The team quickly adjusted to the request, assessed the requirements, and developed a solution that addressed 80% of the needs and could be executed within a very short timeframe. They successfully delivered the feature on schedule, impressing customers with both the functionality and the speed of execution.
  • The team was tasked with developing a solution to reveal Indirect Exposure through cross-chain swaps in response to a competitor's similar feature. Before choosing the technical approach, the team consulted with stakeholders to establish a feasible timeline for the implementation. With this input, the team devised a solution that fit the timeline, communicated the tradeoffs to stakeholders, and successfully delivered the solution as promised.

About TRM's Engineering Levels:

Engineer: Responsible for helping to define project milestones and executing small decision decisions independently with the appropriate tradeoffs between simplicity, readability, and performance. Provides mentorship to junior engineers, and enhances operational excellence through tech debt reduction and knowledge sharing.

Senior Engineer: Successfully designs and documents system improvements and features for an OKR/project from the ground up. Consistently delivers efficient and reusable systems, optimizes team throughput with appropriate tradeoffs, mentors team members, and enhances cross-team collaboration through documentation and knowledge sharing.

Staff Engineer: Drives scoping and execution of one or more OKRs/projects that impact multiple teams. Partners with stakeholders to set the team vision and technical roadmaps for one or more products. Is a role model and mentor to the entire engineering organization. Ensures system health and quality with operational reviews, testing strategies, and monitoring rigor.

Life at TRM Labs

Leadership Principles

Our Leadership Principles are foundational element of our strategy, guiding how we make decisions, how we treat each other, and how we behave day-to-day.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson: We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague: We value humility, candor, and a one-team mindset.

Build a Career

Joining TRM means being part of a mission-driven team comprised of industry leaders. At TRM, you'll experience:

  • Purpose and Mission: Have a real-world impact, from disrupting terrorist networks to returning stolen funds.
  • Inspiring Colleagues: Collaborate with industry leaders and learn something new daily.
  • Personal Growth: We're not just using technology; we're inventing it and taking category-defining products to market.

Work Environment

  • Remote First: Our HQ is online. Tools like Zoom and Slack ensure seamless collaboration, but we also value in-person interactions, organizing regular meetups and offsites for team bonding. Clear communication is key in our decentralized setup. With tools like Slack, Loom, and voice notes, we document meetings and decisions, promoting transparency and efficiency.
  • Ownership & TRM Speed : Small teams drive big goals at TRM. Every team member has significant ownership and responsibility, fostering an environment of initiative and direct impact. While there's no strict clocking in or out, we expect team members to balance personal schedules and team needs. We move “surprisingly fast” while maintaining a high bar in service of our customers and mission. This can feel both intense and rewarding. Our unique approach to projects emphasizes quick wins, rapid iterations, and constant feedback.
  • Diversity and Inclusion : Diversity at TRM encompasses backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Every day is an opportunity to learn from a colleague, whether they're a law enforcement expert or a tech pioneer.
  • Annual Company Offsite : Once a year, TRMers come together from around the world to attend a 1-week mandatory company offsite. This is designed to foster in-person relationships, creativity, and strategic alignment. Employee attendance is required of all TRMers.

Join Us

We're looking for team members who love building from the ground up and want to work hard in a fast-paced and ambitious environment. We are remote-first, with exceptionally talented team members located around the world. If you like solving tough problems quickly and seeing your work improve the lives of billions of people, we want you at TRM.

We encourage you to reach out even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Don't worry about picking exactly the right job; we can always explore other options after starting the conversation. Your passion and interests will set you apart, especially if your background or career is unconventional.

TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.

description:
Chamada para seleção de propostas pesquisa científica: Desmatamento e sistemas alimentares no Brasil

Sobre a oportunidade

1. INTRODUÇÃO E CONTEXTO
A ProVeg Brasil é uma organização dedicada à transformação do sistema alimentar global, visando um futuro mais sustentável para todos, por meio do incentivo de dietas baseadas em vegetais. Reconhecemos a urgência e a complexidade dos desafios ambientais que o Brasil enfrenta, especialmente no que tange ao desmatamento e suas interconexões com os sistemas de produção e consumo de produtos de origem animal.
O Brasil assumiu o compromisso de alcançar o desmatamento zero até 2030, uma meta fundamental para a conservação de biomas de importância global, como a Amazônia e o Cerrado, e para o cumprimento de suas obrigações climáticas internacionais. Neste cenário, a agropecuária é amplamente reconhecida como um dos principais vetores de mudança no uso da terra no país.
Diante da relevância estratégica deste tema, a ProVeg Brasil busca subsidiar suas ações de advocacy e formulação de políticas públicas com evidências científicas robustas.
IMPORTANTE: ESTA NÃO É UMA VAGA DE EMPREGO. EM VEZ DE SE CANDIDATAR ATRAVÉS DO NOSSO SITE, ENVIE SUA PROPOSTA PARA , CONFORME EXPLICADO NA PARTE INFERIOR DESTA PÁGINA.

Detalhes da posição

2. OBJETIVO GERAL
Selecionar a elaboração de uma pesquisa científica para investigar a relação entre o desmatamento no Brasil e os sistemas de produção e consumo de produtos de origem animal, buscando compreender os desafios e as possibilidades para o alcance das metas de desmatamento zero no país.

Responsabilidades

3. ESCOPO DA PESQUISA / TEMAS DE INTERESSE
A pesquisa deverá abordar, de forma abrangente e crítica, os seguintes temas interligados:

  • Desmatamento e Pecuária: Análise da dinâmica e dos impactos da expansão da pecuária (bovina, suína, avícola e outras) e de monoculturas destinadas à alimentação animal sobre o desmatamento em biomas brasileiros, com especial atenção à Amazônia e ao Cerrado.
  • Cadeias de Suprimentos de Produtos de Origem Animal: Investigação do papel de todos os produtos de origem animal e de seus insumos (como a produção de grãos para ração animal, a exemplo da soja) na pressão sobre as florestas e vegetação nativa.
  • Avaliação de Soluções e Limitações: Exame aprofundado do alcance e das limitações de soluções propostas para a sustentabilidade da produção, como a pecuária regenerativa e a intensificação da produção, em relação às metas de desmatamento e à mitigação de emissões de gases de efeito estufa (incluindo o metano).
  • Padrões de Consumo e Produção: Análise dos níveis atuais de produção e consumo de produtos de origem animal no Brasil, considerando tanto o mercado interno quanto as exportações, e suas implicações para o cenário de desmatamento. O estudo deverá explorar cenários e quantificar as transformações necessárias para o alcance das metas de desmatamento zero.

Requisitos

4. RESULTADOS ESPERADOS / ENTREGAS
O trabalho contratado deverá resultar em:

  • Estudo Científico Detalhado: Um relatório de pesquisa completo, com metodologia clara, análise de dados e conclusões embasadas cientificamente. Espera-se que a versão final deste estudo tenha aproximadamente 25-30 páginas.
  • Policy Brief: Um documento conciso e direto, com recomendações estratégicas para guiar as ações de advocacy político da ProVeg Brasil junto a formuladores de políticas, setor privado e sociedade civil.

Mais informações

6. PÚBLICO-ALVO DA CHAMADA
Convidamos pessoas jurídicas (instituições de pesquisa, consultorias, universidades, etc.) com comprovada experiência e expertise nas áreas de desmatamento, sistemas alimentares, pecuária, sustentabilidade, economia ambiental e políticas públicas a submeterem suas propostas.

7. COLABORAÇÃO
A ProVeg Brasil está aberta a colaborar ativamente em todas as etapas do projeto, oferecendo suporte na elaboração do policy brief e na estratégia de divulgação dos resultados. A participação conjunta na publicização dos resultados será bem-vinda e poderá ser acordada.

O isaac é a maior plataforma de soluções financeiras feita para escolas. Impulsionamos as instituições oferecendo receita garantida e proporcionando mais flexibilidade de pagamento para as famílias.

Nosso objetivo é facilitar a gestão financeira, acabando com a dor de cabeça e permitindo que a escola consiga focar na missão de educar , dedicando mais tempo e recursos para tirar os planos do papel.

Nos últimos 4 anos, já ajudamos mais de 2.000 escolas, garantimos mais de R$5bi em mensalidades garantidas, e ajudamos a aumentar em 9% o número de matrículas em nossas escolas parceiras.

A cultura do isaac incentiva a autonomia, a mão na massa, o trabalho em equipe e o uso de dados para construir soluções inovadoras.

Temos muito para construir e transformar na Educação brasileira, e você pode fazer parte dessa revolução, vivenciando o impacto do seu trabalho na sociedade!

Vem com a gente?

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Atuar dentro do time de Crescimento, garantindo entregas de alta performance em um ambiente ambíguo e de constante mudança;
  • Conduzir a atualização mensal de CAC, assegurando alta confiabilidade e aderência à realidade do negócio;
  • Acompanhar o orçamento de despesas da área de Crescimento, identificando riscos de subutilização ou estouro por centro de custo;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos, estruturando soluções escaláveis que aumentem a precisão das informações e automatizem atividades operacionais;
  • Traduzir insights em ações claras e processos robustos, utilizando uma abordagem analítica para identificar problemas e apoiar o aumento da performance de vendas;
  • Manter um relacionamento próximo com as lideranças de Crescimento e com o time de FP&A, promovendo alinhamento contínuo e visibilidade do orçamento.

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharias ou áreas relacionadas
  • Habilidade intermediária em ferramentas de análise de dados (Excel, SQL, etc.)
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal
  • Bom entendimento de regras de negócio e dinâmica de mercado

Diferenciais:

  • Habilidade com ferramentas de visualização de dados (por exemplo, Tableau, Power BI, Metabase)
  • Experiência prévia com análises orçamentárias e planejamento será um diferencial
  • Auxílio alimentação e/ou refeição (Flash flexível - R$40,50/dia);
  • Auxílio home office no primeiro mês de trabalho (R$200,00);
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico Sulamérica sem mensalidade e com coparticipação;
  • Licença maternidade (180 dias) e paternidade (30 dias) estendida;
  • Auxílio creche para mamães e papais com filhos até 06 anos;
  • Cuidado com a saúde física para você e seus dependentes: parceria com a Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Incentivo à educação - parcerias com diversas instituições de ensino;
  • ArcoLab - plataforma de educação corporativa;
  • Desconto em passagens aéreas e hospedagens;
  • Férias flexíveis (antecipação de 15 dias de férias após 6 meses).

Bolsista Mestre - Grupo Boticário - Futuro da Beleza - Vaga Afirmativa Para Talentos Diversos | Talento Inovação -IEL/PR

Recrutamento e Seleção | Recursos Humanos | Educação Corporativa | Treinamento e Desenvolvimento | Estágio | Bolsista de Inovação | Programa Trainee…

O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.

Projeto: Futuro da Beleza - Vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans)

Sobre a Oportunidade:

No Grupo Boticário, acreditamos que inovar é conectar hoje com o amanhã. O projeto tem como propósito apoiar a equipe de Inovação Estratégica de Produtos na estratégia do projeto Futuro da Beleza, identificando as rotas tecnológicas de produto mais promissoras para os próximos anos. Nosso objetivo é traduzir tendências em oportunidades concretas, transformando ciência e tecnologia em valor para milhões de consumidores.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de explorar territórios de inovação já mapeados, caracterizar e quantificar rotas tecnológicas a partir da análise de ICTs, empresas e startups, além de colaborar com áreas estratégicas como marketing, foresight, categoria (embalagem e formulação) e pesquisa.

O resultado esperado é a conexão entre a estratégia de inovação de curto prazo e as de médio e longo prazo, garantindo maior eficiência na identificação de oportunidades tecnológicas em PD&I. Se você tem perfil analítico, curiosidade para explorar novas fronteiras da ciência e vontade de gerar impacto real no futuro da beleza, que desejam cocriar conosco o amanhã da beleza.

Essa vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans).

Formação Acadêmica: Mestre em Engenharia, Biotecnologia, Química, Farmácia, Analytics, Data Science, Estratégia ou Marketing.

Idioma: Inglês - Nível avançado (leitura).

Principais Atividades:

  • Realizar buscas em bases de dados já pré-definidas na metodologia, mapear e consolidar as tecnologias levantadas.
  • Fazer a análise crítica dos dados obtidos e cruzar com estratégia de inovação do Grupo Boticário.
  • Caracterizar as rotas tecnológicas identificadas de acordo com metodologia pré-definida.
  • Calibrar pesquisa com consumidores e realizar consolidação do material e análise crítica dos resultados.
  • Construir a apresentação do relatório final.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar os dados obtidos e conectá-los com os relatórios estratégicos obtidos e liderados por outras áreas do Grupo Boticário;
  • Curiosidade e proatividade na busca por informações;
  • Capacidade de síntese e comunicação clara;
  • Interesse em inovação e novas tecnologias;
  • Conhecimento em foresight estratégico;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados (google sheets);

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Experiência em foresight estratégico na área;
  • Conhecimento da indústria de cosméticos;
  • Desejável experiência em interpretação de escrita científica;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados (looker);
  • Comunicação;
  • Criatividade.
  • Capacidade analítica;

Formato de trabalho: Remoto

Overview

The Opportunity

Provide hardware and software installation and configuration services to support the delivery of Hitachi’s SCADA/EMS/DMS/OMS systems and applications. Additionally, you will be responsible for delivering configured systems using product implementation standards approved by Network Control. This position will offer hands-on knowledge of regional market needs and contribute to the standardization of the delivery process.

Responsibilities

  • Setup and configuration of computers and servers including: IP and network id configuration, firmware updates, disk setup and partitioning, OS installation and hardening
  • Use of automation tool Ansible
  • Installation and configuration of Linux and Windows operating systems.

  • Installation and configuration of ABB Network Manager multitier applications (SCADA/EMS/DMS/OMS).
  • Administration of system software inventory and project release management
  • Develop, coordinate, and implement plans to test business and functional processes during system development and quality assurance testing.
  • Create or assist others in the writing of user documentation, instructions, and procedures.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Basic understanding of TCP/IP networks in client-server environments.
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft technologies, including Active Directory, DNS, and Group Policy.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as PowerShell, VBS, Linux Shell Script, or Perl.
  • Advanced English (Mandatory).
  • Availability to travel.

  • Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership .

  • Validation rules, approval processes, and assignment rules.
  • Reports, dashboards, and list views.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into system solutions.

If you’re passionate about game development, eager to showcase and improve your skills on major titles, and open to potential partnerships down the line, we encourage you to apply and become part of our expert talent community. We look forward to connecting with you.

A 3D generalist is a multi-talented professional capable of managing various facets of the 3D production process, including modeling, texturing, lighting, rigging, animation, rendering, and compositing. They embody versatility, adaptability, and creativity, making them well-suited for diverse projects and genres.

Here's what you can expect

  • Profile preselection: Our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile to ensure it aligns with our requirements and values
  • Talent Acquisition Interview: Selected candidates will discuss their experience, skills, and fit for the role
  • Online Test: Qualified candidates will be invited to complete an online assessment
  • Technical Interview: Finalists will participate in a technical interview to assess proficiency and compatibility with our team when a project staffing plan is made

We’re committed to finding the best talent to join our growing team and look forward to connecting with you throughout this process.

The Quest

  • Concept interpretation : Translate 2D concepts and references into high-quality 3D models or sculpts with fidelity to the original design while adding necessary details to achieve leveling, style and craftsmanship with minimal direction.
  • High poly modeling and sculpting : Use industry-standard software to create detailed models that tell a story and meet artistic and technical requirements for the project.
  • Low poly and mid poly creation : Create game-ready versions with optimized topology, efficient UVs, and meeting technical requirements.
  • Textures creation : Use Photoshop and Substance Painter to create high-quality texture maps that accurately represent materials and align with project style.
  • Rigging and animation support : Collaborate with animators and riggers to prepare models for animation, providing clean topology and rig-friendly meshes, and help integrate animations into the game engine.
  • Optimization and performance : Optimize assets for performance and memory usage, implementing LODs and other techniques.
  • Asset integration : Export assets and integrate them in a game engine.
  • Efficient time management : Work efficiently to meet phase timelines and delivery dates.
  • Teamwork : Collaborate with other artists to solve problems and communicate about quality, technical, or delivery issues.
  • Punctuality : Present progress daily and/or when requested, and assist in meetings as needed.

The Skills

  • Strong polygonal modeling skills with clean, efficient, well-integrated and leveled models that meet project requirements.
  • Understanding of technical foundations to manage assets for memory and performance considerations.
  • Strong artistic sensibilities related to color theory, composition, scale, design, shape language, and craft basics, with understanding of proportions and industrial design.
  • PBR workflow and efficient/organized texture creation, with understanding of physically based workflows to achieve believable assets and story.
  • Familiarity with game engines such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
  • High degree of self-direction while being a team player with strong verbal and written communication, and openness to feedback.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and proactive approach to technical and artistic challenges in 3D asset creation.
  • Strong knowledge of pipelines , workflows and asset exporting processes.
  • Quick learner of new processes and software as needed.
  • 3–5 years of experience in the video game industry and at least 3 credited games.

Software Expertise

  • Maya, 3ds Max, Blender or equivalent software
  • Unreal Engine 5 and Unity
  • ZBrush
  • Adobe Photoshop
  • Substance Painter
  • Substance Designer is a plus

Required Application Materials

  • Resume/CV
  • Cover letter
  • Reel or portfolio demonstrating the art and technical skills

The Reward

  • Competitive project-based compensation
  • Opportunity to work on exciting and diverse projects
  • Clear communication and support throughout the project duration
  • Flexibility in project timelines and deadlines
  • Potential for long-term collaboration on future projects
  • Transparent and fair evaluation of your work

description:
Sobre a Lemon

As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta. A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. Entregamos uma energia diferente da tradicional, por isso conseguimos oferecer uma conta de luz mais econômica e sustentável. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, por isso garantimos sempre um atendimento mais próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico. Somos apoiados pelos principais investidores em tecnologia de todo o mundo, incluindo fundos de venture capital como Kaszek, Lowercarbon Capital, Canary, Big Bets e Actyus. Endereçar um dos desafios mais significativos do mundo requer pensamento inovador e perspectivas diversas. Estamos construindo um time de pessoas com diferentes experiências, repertório profissional e formações educacionais. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão de criar essa a nova era da energia limpa, estamos ansiosos para conhecer o que de único você traz para Lemon.

Sobre a área de Design

Design na Lemon tem um papel estratégico para alcançar nossa missão. Como designer de produto, você terá protagonismo e voz para impactar a vida de milhares de pessoas com experiências simples e eficazes. Somos responsáveis por entender dores e necessidades dos clientes, levantar hipóteses, pesquisar, testar e projetar de ponta a ponta os produtos da Lemon. Atuamos lado a lado com Product Managers, Engenheiros e Data Analysts, em times colaborativos e orientados a resultados.

O que você vai fazer por aqui

Como Senior Product Designer, você será peça-chave na criação de soluções centradas no usuário que traduzem problemas complexos em experiências intuitivas e funcionais.

  • Liderar o trabalho de design em áreas de produto do discovery à entrega incluindo fluxos, wireframes, protótipos e design visual;
  • Colaborar com PMs, engenheiros, researchers e marketing para criar experiências que conectem tecnologia e pessoas;
  • Contribuir na definição da estratégia de design e atuar na execução em áreas críticas do produto;
  • Traduzir desafios complexos em soluções claras, utilizáveis e envolventes;
  • Trazer a perspectiva de design para discussões de planejamento, priorização e trade-offs de produto;
  • Conduzir ou apoiar pesquisas com usuários e aplicar os aprendizados nas decisões de design;
  • Evoluir e manter nosso design system, promovendo consistência e escalabilidade;
  • Compartilhar seu trabalho com frequência, usando documentação, protótipos e sessões de feedback;
  • Representar e defender a voz do usuário, equilibrando necessidades do negócio e limitações técnicas.

Perfil que buscamos

  • Se entusiasma com problemas difíceis técnicos, de produto ou de negócio;
  • Tem experiência e gosta de colaborar com times multidisciplinares;
  • Se comunica de forma clara e confortável com diferentes públicos;
  • Tem interesse por sustentabilidade, energia ou sistemas complexos;
  • Ya viveu experiências desafiadoras que fortalecem sua autonomia e confiança.

Experiência prévia / habilidades exigidas

  • 5+ anos de experiência em Product/UX Design, com portfólio digital relevante;
  • Histórico sólido em entregar experiências ponta a ponta em ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Excelência em design de interface e interação, com foco em soluções simples e funcionais;
  • Familiaridade com métodos de pesquisa e aplicação de insights no processo de design;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura da informação, prototipação e usabilidade;
  • Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas;
  • Boa compreensão de métricas, dados e KPIs de produto;
  • Conhecimento técnico suficiente para colaborar bem com desenvolvedores.

As a UI (User Interface) Artist, you will be responsible for creating visually appealing and intuitive user interfaces for mobile games and apps. You will collaborate closely with game designers, artists, and developers to design, implement, and optimize UI elements that enhance the overall gameplay experience and engage players.

The purpose of the role is to conceptualize, mock-up, and execute interface designs across many different systems, creating a visual and functional connection between the user experience and the game story. You will work with us to design and develop user interface styles, structures and flows integrated in our projects, augmenting gameplay systems and complementing the established art direction.

  • Profile Preselection: Our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile to ensure it aligns with our requirements and values.
  • Talent Acquisition Interview: Selected candidates will undergo an initial interview to discuss their experience, skills, and fit for the role.
  • Online Test: Qualified candidates will be invited to complete an online assessment to demonstrate their abilities.
  • Technical Interview: Finalists will participate in a technical interview to assess their proficiency and compatibility with our team when a project staffing plan is made.

We're committed to finding the best talent to join our growing team, and we look forward to connecting with you throughout this exciting process.

The Quest

  • UI Design: Create concept sketches, wireframes, and mockups for various UI screens, including menus, HUDs (Heads-Up Displays), overlays, and interactive elements. Develop cohesive visual themes and styles that align with the game's aesthetic and target audience.
  • Graphic Asset Creation: Design and produce high-quality UI assets, including icons, buttons, backgrounds, and visual effects. Use graphic design software to create scalable and visually appealing UI elements that enhance usability and accessibility.
  • Iconography and Typography: Select appropriate icons, symbols, and typography to convey information, enhance navigation, and communicate game mechanics effectively. Ensure consistency in iconography style, color schemes, and typography across all UI screens.
  • Animation and Motion Graphics: Implement animations and motion graphics to enhance interactivity, feedback, and visual interest within the UI. Create dynamic transitions, button animations, and visual effects that respond to player interactions and events.
  • User Experience (UX) Optimization: Conduct user research, playtesting, and usability testing to gather feedback and insights on UI design and functionality. Iterate on UI layouts, navigation flows, and interactive elements to improve user engagement, retention, and satisfaction.
  • Technical Implementation: Work closely with developers to integrate UI assets into the game engine (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine) and ensure optimal performance across various mobile devices and screen resolutions. Collaborate on UI scripting and implementation tasks as needed.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with game designers, artists, programmers, and producers to align UI design goals with gameplay mechanics, narrative elements, and technical constraints. Participate in brainstorming sessions and provide creative input to enhance the overall game experience.
  • Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing and QA checks to ensure UI elements function as intended, adhere to design specifications, and meet performance targets. Identify and address any UI-related bugs, glitches, or usability issues in a timely manner.

The Skills

  • Strong understanding of design principles, color theory, typography, and composition. Ability to create visually appealing and cohesive UI designs that enhance usability and aesthetics.
  • Ability to bring static UI elements to life through dynamic animations and visual effects. Experience with animation software (e.g., After Effects, Spine) and a passion for creating engaging animations and motion graphics within UI.
  • User-Centered Design , knowledge of UX principles and methodologies, including user research, usability testing, and iterative design. Ability to empathize with users and advocate for their needs throughout the UI design process.
  • Best practices for designing UI interfaces for touchscreen devices. Experience with mobile game engines (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine) is a plus. Familiarity with mobile gaming industry and platform-specific UI/UX guidelines.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to convey ideas, concepts, and feedback to cross-functional team members. Comfortable giving and receiving constructive criticism in a team-oriented environment.
  • Creative thinking and a passion for pushing the boundaries of UI design in mobile games. Ability to solve design challenges, iterate on ideas, and adapt to feedback and changing project requirements.

Software Expertise

  • Unity and Unreal engines
  • GitHub/SourceTree/Fork/Perforce
  • Miro/Confluence/Basecamp
  • Sketch, Adobe XD, Axure RP, Marvel, Affinity Designer, Balsamiq, Principle and Framer are a plus

  • Resume/CV
  • Cover letter
  • Reel or Portfolio demonstrating the art and technical skills

The Reward

  • Opportunity to work on exciting and diverse projects
  • Clear communication and support throughout the project duration
  • Flexibility in project timelines and deadlines
  • Potential for long-term collaboration on future projects
  • Transparent and fair evaluation of your work

About The Role

As a Staff Product Manager, Checkout , you will be responsible for defining and executing the future of checkout at VTEX. You will work closely with engineering, design, growth, and commercial teams to ensure we build and scale a best-in-class checkout experience for both B2B and B2C customers. You will play a crucial role in increasing conversion rates by leading the development and adoption of VTEX's Fast Checkout, an innovative, seamless, and high-performance solution that aligns with the latest industry standards. You will define the next phase of this product, taking it from launch to full adoption.

About The Team

The Checkout team is responsible for one of the most critical parts of the shopping experience: ensuring a frictionless and high-converting checkout process. The team is developing a new product designed to redefine how businesses handle both B2B and B2C transactions.

What You Will Do

  • Define and prioritize the future of checkout at VTEX, identifying key investments and areas for innovation.
  • Collaborate with engineering and design teams to develop and launch new features that improve checkout efficiency and conversion rates.
  • Influence internal teams, including our main platform FastStore.
  • Lead the adoption strategy for the new FastCheckout, including the migration of existing customers from legacy solutions.
  • Develop and maintain a clear product roadmap, balancing short-term impact with long-term strategic growth.
  • Partner with Growth and Commercial teams to align go-to-market strategies and ensure successful product adoption.
  • Use data-driven decision-making to optimize checkout performance and enhance the user experience.

Who You Are

  • Experienced Product Leader: Strong background in product management, ideally in e-commerce, fintech, or checkout-related products.
  • Data-Driven Decision Maker: Strong analytical skills with experience using data to inform product strategies and measure success.
  • Strategic Thinker: Ability to define long-term product visions while executing short-term tactical improvements.
  • Execution-Oriented: Comfortable leading cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, agile environment.
  • Customer-Centric: Deep understanding of customer needs, pain points, and behaviors in digital commerce.
  • Strong Communicator: Ability to influence and align stakeholders across different teams and levels of the organization.
  • Industry Experience (preferred but not required): Familiarity with e-commerce platforms or checkout flows is a plus.

About VTEX

VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers more efficiency and less maintenance to organizations seeking to make smarter IT investments and modernize their tech stack. Through our pragmatic composability approach, we empower brands, distributors, and retailers with unparalleled flexibility and comprehensive solutions, enabling them to invest solely in what provides a clear business advantage and boosts profitability. VTEX is trusted by 2,400 global B2C and B2B customers, including Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker, and Whirlpool, with 3,400 active online stores across 43 countries (as of FY ended on December 31, 2024).

Founded in 2000, VTEX has a history of growth and disruption in the industry. VTEX is building an extraordinary future with more than 1,300 employees across 25 locations in 16 countries in Latin America, North America, Europe, and Asia. For more information, visit .

At VTEX, you will work in a challenge-driven environment and collaborate with amazing peers. If you are powerful individually, join us, and we will be unstoppable together.

description:
Overview

At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you’re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.

We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth stor y while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let\'s start the conversation.

At Iron Mountain we protect what our customers value most, from the everyday to the extraordinary. We build customer value around the world with a passion for preserving the physical, transforming the digital, and respecting the environmental. We pioneered the industry for global records and information management and have established some of the best customer relationships in the industry with 95% of the Fortune 1000 companies among our 225,000 loyal customers. Here, you’ll bring your expertise and creativity to a workplace that thrives on continuous improvement. Here, you’ll be part of a global workforce that embraces the differences among us. And here, we’ll encourage you to Climb Higher for the benefit of our customers and each other. There is so much more, but enough about us. We can’t wait to hear about YOU.

Iron Mountain has been an essential and trusted partner to 95% of Fortune 1000 companies and the world’s largest public organizations for more than 70 years. As a world leader in Records and Information Management, we have been proud custodians of our clients’ brand reputation, safeguarding their most important records, information and assets. But we are so much more. We help our clients with Workplace Transformation, Digital Transformation, IT and Data Security and Sustainability. We have a leading portfolio of digital workflow solutions, Asset Life Cycle Management, a network of world-class Data Centers, and more. We uncover insights and new ways of working that help our clients find the gold in their mountain of data…and elevate the power of their work.

Overview

The Global Industries Partner Manager is responsible for developing and executing on the partner “sell with” strategy for assigned Consulting and SI Partners, driving revenue growth, as well as managing and influencing positive business outcomes for our joint customers.

The Partner Manager has shared ownership of sustainable growth with the assigned partners, owning building out and executing a jointly beneficial partnership plan. Role will drive market analysis, understanding the partner’s partner ecosystem, determining the optimal solution and GTM alignment, building commercials and developing enablement and support systems to manage the partner program. Additionally, this position will own lead development, coordinating sales activities including aligning IRM account owners with their corresponding partner sales persons, and overall relationship management.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of the Systems Integrator / Consulting landscape and how to traverse those types of organizations, and know how to successfully lead solution identification and valuation with a partner. The candidate should also have a proven track record of success in partner sales and marketing as well as underlying contracting needed to support multinational efforts as identified. The Partner Manager will work closely with all internal solution SMEs and end user assigned sellers to create a seamless experience for both the end user and partner selling organization.

Responsibilities

  • Develops and executes business plan to create incremental pipeline through assigned SI / Consulting partners. Business Plan to include account prioritization and comprehensive partnership engagement model, execution and ongoing maintenance for prioritized accounts.

  • Identifies market validation and longer term strategic opportunities through Account Strategy and jGTM activity.

  • Develop and own exceptional client relationships that cross many verticals, including Financial Services, Healthcare and Life Sciences, Media and Entertainment, Public Sector, Energy, etc.

  • Build, leverage and communicate Iron Mountain Partnership benefits to key stakeholders within Iron Mountain, focus on the strategic nature of the partner relationship to build long-term value and sustainable success for both Iron Mountain and our Partner.

  • Direct and influence lead generation activities to generate pipeline, align with Sales teams on GTM plays to ensure alignment on goals by providing updated business plan(s) and sharing of best practices across regions.

  • Develops and manages joint Inside/Field Sales processes including deal assignment and registration with the Iron Mountain and partner sales teams, collaborates with Iron Mountain and partner teams to organize joint sales calls.

  • Collaborates with Iron Mountain and Partner Sales Organizations in support of sales campaigns, proposals and closure. Drives team mindshare through regular communication (win stories etc.) and relationship cadence.

  • Enable sales teams (Iron Mountain and Partner) on GTM plays by providing both teams with the relevant knowledge in terms of sales, presales and technical knowledge to effectively grow revenue.

  • Works with IRM field sales to ensure account opportunity visibility into Iron Mountain SFDC tracking pipeline, ensuring appropriate reporting and joint execution plan execution with the partner sales team.

  • Works closely with the Product Marketing, Presales and Product Management teams to develop structured marketing and enablement plans as part of the overall business plans for execution. Manage Iron Mountain / Partner engagement escalations and conflicts

Key Skills, Requirements and Competencies:

  • 5+ year’s successful partner ownership, including business plan development and execution through sales alignment and pipeline development, preferably with large global Systems Integrators, Business Process Outsourcers and / or large global Consulting Organizations.

  • Successful complex solution sales experience in at least one of the following domains (digital transformation, data centers, asset lifecycle management, information management).

  • Exceptional proven sales success working directly with Customer decision makers and key stakeholders

  • Enthusiastic, inclusive, positive, highly energetic.

  • Domain Expertise in one (or more) of the following sectors; Financial Services, Energy, Technology, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Insurance, Manufacturing, etc will be helpful

  • Experience as a strategic account lead for a large and complex global organization, managing relationships with Fortune 100 level customers.

  • Experience working across all levels of a highly matrixed global organization.

  • Strategic mindset and highly consultative approach to partnering with internal and external teams

  • Comfortable in a startup environment

What is Sylvera anyway?

Sylvera provides trusted ratings, tools and data for carbon credits and CDR. Our mission is to incentivize investment in real climate action.

Purchasing carbon credits and CDR through the carbon markets is one of the most established and scalable ways to channel finance to effective climate solutions and work toward societal net zero. Unfortunately, the carbon markets were plagued with mistrust and a lack of effectiveness since they’ve emerged – until Sylvera.

To help organizations ensure they\'re making the most effective investments, Sylvera provides trusted ratings, tools and data for carbon credits and CDR. Our data and software independently and accurately validates the impact of carbon projects that capture, remove, or avoid emission whether they are up and running, or in development. With Sylvera businesses, governments and developers can confidently invest in, benchmark, deliver, and report real climate impact.

Our team is made up of leading minds in climate change from scientists to policy, finance, and carbon market experts. We work in partnership with scientific organizations, universities, governments, and think tanks to develop and implement rigorous and holistic project assessment methodologies, leveraging the latest technology. 1 month ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Do you geek out on Media Buying and love driving revenue through direct response marketing?

Want to get in the door at an extremely fast growing marketing agency?

Want to work with world class copywriters, videographers, operations, and other media buyers, to help clients grow to new heights?

Well then look no further!

As we continue to grow our advertising agency, Client Accelerators is seeking a Senior Media Buyer to research, strategize, & then run ads across YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, Google & other platforms.

We currently spend over $3 Million Dollars a Month across these platforms and you'll be helping increase that to $5 Million a month this year.

You will be working with some of the biggest names in the expert & consulting industry, clients like Russell Brunson, Anik Singal, Mike Tyson, Russ Ruffino, & many more.

You'll work within a pod of videographers, copywriters, strategists, and data scientists to plan each client, forecast the targets we need to hit, script & direct each creative, then launch and work to hit forecasted targets every single quarter.

Responsibilities

  • Media Buying: We work across a ton of different advertising platforms, mainly YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, Google Search & Display. You will be managing upwards of $50,000 - $75,000 a day on these platforms. Some of our clients will scale very hard when we hit a winning campaign, so you will need to be prepared to do so.
  • Forecasting: You will be forecasting & creating different scenarios to hit clients targets. This includes mapping out current ad metrics, conversion rates & coming up with new improved forecasts based upon us lowering CPC, increasing conversion rates, etc..
  • Data Driven Decision Making: In our company, every decision is based upon data. You will be compiling and analyzing performance data for ad creative, landing pages, and offers to assess effectiveness and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Funnel Strategy: Every client we work with has a sales funnel and you will need to be able to identify where there are pages in the funnel that aren’t hitting industry benchmarks. This will allow us to increase conversion rate & drive more revenue with the same amount of traffic.
  • Creative Strategy: Creative is at the heart of everything we do. Great creative is the key to actually scaling on paid traffic (All other things being equal). You will be working with our creative team to come up with new angles, big ideas, and ultimately drive creative strategy for our clients. Brainstorm new and creative growth strategies and campaign ideas that set us apart from the competition.
  • Competitor Research: At CA, we don't throw sh*t up against the wall and hope it sticks. We look at what's already working in a particular niche, and look to use that to inspire what we do with ads & funnels that we are running. No need to reinvent the wheel

Results

  • These are the specific results you will be expected to deliver every week, month, quarter & year.
  • Achieve 95% of Projected Quarterly Bonus Compensation Targets for Assigned Clients
  • Achieve 85% of All Projected Clients' Quarterly Profit & ROAS Goals
  • Successfully Ramp 100% of New Junior Media Buyers to Full Productivity Within 3 Months

Success in Your First Two to Four Months Looks Like

  • Seamlessly building ad account structures in line with CA best practices. This includes having structures that are backed by solid reasoning, follow naming conventions, and aim to test and/or scale a specific strategy. You will have the ability to problem solve and overcome most account issues that you encounter.
  • Having confidence in scaling and optimizing ad accounts and understanding of success as it relates to client needs.
  • Working with your team to ideate creative concepts and new advertising campaigns based on past best-performing sales and promotions.
  • Understand what is happening in accounts across the company as a whole and be able to apply these learnings to your own ad accounts. take full ownership over your ad accounts while managing up to 5-7 clients.
  • Competency in utilizing Hyros, Google Sheets, & data analytics reporting to provide meaningful and actionable insights.
  • Managing a full client roster (5-7 clients) and building great client relationships. This includes daily communication/updates as well as hitting set monthly KPI goals based on ROAS and spend.
  • Collaborate with other CA team members on optimization techniques and scaling strategies across ad accounts. You are always curious to learn more and understand that working together is almost always better than trying to solve difficult problems yourself

COMMUNICATION EXPECTATIONS

  • We use Slack for Internal & Client Communications
  • We value over-communication (more context the better)
  • We value speed in communication (be prompt in responding or provide context as to why you may be slow to respond)
  • Weekly Full Team Meetings
  • Daily Stand Ups with Pod Leads

WHO ARE WE?

Client Accelerators is the 'go to' company for coaches, consultants, experts, & authors who want to achieve sustained growth through paid acquisition channels like YouTube, Facebook, TikTok & Google.

We were the 207th fastest growing company on the Inc 5000 list last year, and have had record growth for an advertising agency, growing an incredible 2,574% over the past 3 years.

We've been able to have this record growth because of the incredible results we've been able to get for our clients, which has allowed us to speak on stages all over the world on our strategies & tactics to doubling, tripling or even 10x their profits by working with us.

We take a hands-on approach to growing each client we bring in by scripting all of their creatives, video production, tracking, & running their ads on these channels to hit agreed upon targets.

Our proven approach has allowed us to spend over $150 Million Dollars & generate over $300 Million Dollars in verified sales in the past 5 years. Currently, our company is focused on founder-led businesses across the e-learning, SaaS and service-based internet space.

We believe great people are at the center of every successful business. Employees are provided a full suite of benefits, including competitive compensation, healthcare, unlimited paid time off, and a fully remote working environment. (We also have offices in New Jersey, Georgia, & Florida if you'd prefer to work in-person ).

What makes Client Accelerators so different? For one, our founder, Mike Buontempo is a consultant himself, who has been consulting with different companies & entrepreneurs for the past 13 years.

Our vision is to attract and hire the very best people to help our clients grow profitably and systematically through paid media.

Client Accelerators Core Values

  • We Are Problem Solvers: If you spot a problem in our company or a client's company, provide a solution. There's millions of problems, and not as many problem solvers, be the solution.
  • Open Source Code: We share what's working with everyone
  • Empty The Bucket: Picture this, if you just spent two hours cleaning your car, you put all of the cleaning materials away, but you notice you missed a spot. What do you do? You go back, get everything back out, and complete the job to perfection
  • We're a ‘TEAM' not a Family: Leaders at CA hire, develop, and cut smartly, so we have Superstars at every position
  • Ownership Thinking: Going out of your way to make sure your actions and the actions of your peers are in the best interest of the company
  • Being The Best: Mastering your domain so you're the best in the world at it

Requirements

  • 3+ years of Digital Marketing Experience with hands-on experience in optimizing conversion-based funnels
  • 3+ years of Media Buying Team Management experience
  • Experience with Webinar and Coaching Funnels will be preferred.
  • Intellectually curious. "That's interesting" must be the impetus that starts you on the path to find out what, why, and how. Unique results are the seeds of immense gain
  • Upload and launch digital advertising campaigns
  • Increase traffic & revenue growth through advertising channels like YouTube, Facebook, Search & Display

  • Proven ability to prioritize multiple projects with short- and long-term deadlines

  • Brainstorm new and creative growth strategies and campaign ideas that set us apart from the competition
  • Monitor industry trends and competitors' approaches

  • Assign requests to the appropriate records team members based on workload balance and utilization metrics.

4. Handling Special Cases

  • Resolve missing, unclear, or conflicting information by liaising with the law firms case manager.

Requirements

  • Experience: Prior hands-on experience requesting health records from providers on behalf of law firms.
  • Attention to Detail: Exceptional accuracy; even small mistakes can cause delays of several months.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with Adobe Acrobat and other PDF editing/combining tools.

  • Colaborar em iniciativas de modernização e integração, sem definir arquitetura, garantindo aderência a padrões corporativos e compatibilidade com a arquitetura vigente.

Sobre Você (About You)

  • Experiência prática como desenvolvedor(a) de software (Java ou Node.js) e conhecimento de front-end (Angular ou React) suficiente para discutir trade-offs e revisar impactos técnicos.
  • Vivência com ciclo de desenvolvimento de software e metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban): planejamento, refinamento, dailies, reviews e retrospectivas.
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura de software aplicado à análise e priorização (padrões de design, microsserviços, APIs, DDD, event-driven), sem atribuição de definir arquitetura.

  • Conhecimento de segurança de aplicações (OWASP, secrets, IAM) e compliance.
  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de governança técnica (arquitetura evolutiva, tech radar, OKRs técnicos).

  • Impacto Social: Dois dias de voluntariado pagos anualmente e oportunidades para participar de projetos de consultoria pro bono e iniciativas ESG.
  • Fazendo um Impacto Real no Mundo: Ao lado de clientes e instituições, contribuímos para justiça, verdade e transparência, apoiando o estado de direito, o comércio e a detecção de infratores.

Quem somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. About The Job

We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Architect who brings real-world architecture experience and excels in working collaboratively with engineers, designers and stakeholders. The role involves deeply understanding our tech stack (for apps, SDKs, SaaS platforms, etc.) and applying that knowledge to design scalable systems that adhere to our design principles.

Responsibilities

  • Design robust and scalable architectures for all sorts of systems (apps, SDKs, SaaS platforms, etc.) that are tailor-made for our specific tech stack. Use systems-level thinking to structure components for reliability, scalability and maintainability.

  • Past experience developing or architecting successful and scalable applications. Experience with P2P is great to have.

  • Skilled in collaborating and communicating technical ideas in a clear, concise, and friendly manner across diverse teams.
  • Proficiency in creating and managing architectural artifacts like diagrams, specs, and documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and an aptitude for simplifying complex technical challenges.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

Important information for candidates

  • Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

Software Engineering Manager - Container and Virtualisation Infrastructure

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Container and Virtualisation Infrastructure role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Our mission is to build a next-generation private cloud infrastructure, combining KVM, Ceph, and SDN technologies to create a data center scale cloud that 'just works' and provides a mission-critical cloud for edge and core enterprise deployments. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality microservice architectures and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux kernel, virtualisation, storage and networking.
LXD components span the entire software stack from low-level kernel features to the upper level management API/CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
As an engineering manager at Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
The successful candidate will have experience leading successful, collaborative engineering teams, and demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems and deep knowledge of Linux.
Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA and the Americas.
What you will focus on

  • Lead a team of remote engineers
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Participate in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Work from home with global travel for 4 to 6 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You understand modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8s
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have strong written and verbal technical communication skills
  • You have experience programming in C and/or Go.
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Sobre a Empresa

A Fundação José Silveira (FJS) é uma instituição privada, sem fins lucrativos, com quase nove décadas de história. Reconhecida como de utilidade pública, atua fortemente nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa e projetos socioambientais , sempre pautada pelo compromisso social e pela transparência na gestão de recursos públicos.

Com sede em Salvador e atuação em diversas regiões do Estado, a FJS é referência no Terceiro Setor , conduzindo contratos em parceria com órgãos públicos das esferas municipal, estadual e federal.

Cultura e Equipe

A cultura organizacional é guiada por valores como ética, responsabilidade social, inovação e excelência em gestão . A Fundação valoriza o trabalho colaborativo, estimulando a troca de conhecimento entre diferentes áreas, a capacitação contínua e o fortalecimento das equipes.

Na Controladoria, o ambiente é dinâmico e desafiador, reunindo profissionais comprometidos com a conformidade contábil e legal e com a missão institucional da FJS. A área de Prestação de Contas atua como elo estratégico entre contabilidade, faturamento, jurídico e setores técnicos, assegurando a rastreabilidade e a integridade das informações.

Sobre a Vaga

Garantir conformidade na aplicação e prestação de contas dos recursos públicos, atendendo às exigências legais, contratuais e dos órgãos fiscalizadores.

Supervisionar e orientar a equipe , assegurando qualidade, prazos e integridade das informações.

Coordenar processos contábeis e financeiros , incluindo encerramento do exercício e publicação das demonstrações.

Atuar de forma estratégica , elaborando relatórios gerenciais, indicadores e apoiando a tomada de decisão.

Representar a área em auditorias , prestando esclarecimentos técnicos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar a equipe responsável pela elaboração e análise das prestações de contas financeiras e técnicas, assegurando conformidade com os contratos de gestão, convênios, termos de colaboração e demais instrumentos firmados com entes públicos das esferas municipal, estadual e federal.
  • Coordenar a organização, validação e arquivamento da documentação comprobatória da aplicação dos recursos públicos (notas fiscais, recibos, folhas de pagamento, extratos bancários, relatórios de execução e comprovantes de recolhimento de encargos sociais, etc.).
  • Acompanhar a escrituração e análise dos registros contábeis relacionados às prestações de contas, assegurando a consistência das informações lançadas e a correta vinculação às rubricas contratuais.
  • Coordenar os processos de encerramento do exercício contábil e garantir a adequada elaboração e publicação das demonstrações contábeis dos contratos, em conformidade com as normas vigentes e exigências contratuais e legais.
  • Controlar os prazos de entrega das prestações de contas e relatórios contábeis, garantindo atendimento às cláusulas contratuais e legislações aplicáveis.
  • Atuar como elo entre a área de prestação de contas e os setores de contabilidade, faturamento, suprimentos, jurídico e assistência, assegurando a rastreabilidade e integridade dos dados.
  • Fornecer orientação técnica à equipe e às unidades executoras quanto à correta aplicação dos recursos públicos e ao atendimento das demandas dos órgãos fiscalizadores.
  • Elaborar e apresentar relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de desempenho, oferecendo suporte à tomada de decisão estratégica e à melhoria contínua dos processos de controle institucional.
  • Representar a área perante auditorias internas e externas, prestando esclarecimentos técnicos sempre que necessário.
  • Manter-se atualizado e disseminar à equipe a legislação e normas aplicáveis ao Terceiro Setor e à gestão de recursos públicos.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação acadêmica: Bacharelado em Ciências Contábeis.
  • Experiência: Vivência prévia em supervisão ou coordenação de equipes; experiência mínima de 3 a 5 anos em rotinas contábeis e prestação de contas, preferencialmente no Terceiro Setor ou em instituições que atuem em parcerias com o poder público.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos: Legislação e normas contábeis; Legislação e normas de gestão de recursos públicos e Terceiro Setor; Domínio do Pacote Office (nível intermediário/avançado em Excel); Conhecimento de sistemas de gestão contábil e financeira (ERP); Desejável domínio de plataformas de prestação de contas e relatórios físico-financeiros.

Habilidades e Competências

  • Liderança e capacidade de coordenação de equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e foco em prazos.
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretação de documentos contábeis, financeiros e legais.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade para interface institucional.
  • Proatividade, visão sistêmica e habilidade de negociação.

title: Gerente de infraestrutura de tecnologia da informação
description:
Sobre Nós

Já pensou em fazer parte de uma empresa que é referência em TI, impulsionando a inovação e transformando o mercado desde 2001?

Venha para a Qualificar TI!

Na Qualificar TI, somos especialistas em Governança de Dados, Gerenciamento de Projetos, Transformação Digital e Outsourcing. Oferecemos soluções estratégicas e as melhores práticas para atender às necessidades técnicas de nossos clientes.

O Que Buscamos

Procuramos gente apaixonada por tecnologia, que quer crescer e se desenvolver num ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. Queremos pessoas que:

  • Tenham perfil de Transformação Digital e sejam inovadoras.
  • Busquem continuamente por conhecimento e aprimoramento.
  • Sejam proativas e comprometidas com a entrega de resultados.
  • Valorizem o compartilhamento de experiências e o trabalho em equipe.

Por Que Trabalhar na Qualificar TI?

  • Ambiente Inovador: Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com um time dedicado e dinâmico, que valoriza o seu conhecimento e incentiva o seu crescimento.
  • Desenvolvimento Contínuo : Oferecemos um espaço onde a aprendizagem e o desenvolvimento são contínuos, proporcionando a você as ferramentas e o suporte necessários para crescer profissionalmente.
  • Impacto Real: Contribua para projetos que realmente fazem a diferença para nossos clientes, utilizando as melhores práticas e soluções tecnológicas.

Se identificou? Então, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Sobre a oportunidade

Responsável por coordenar a operação da infraestrutura de TIC, envolvendo servidores, redes, bancos de dados e segurança. A atuação exige visão estratégica, capacidade de liderança técnica e foco em alta disponibilidade e continuidade dos serviços.

Atividades principais

  • Supervisionar as equipes técnicas de infraestrutura (N3 e NOC);
  • Planejar e monitorar a operação contínua dos serviços de TIC;
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos SLAs, segurança da informação e estabilidade da operação;
  • Apoiar técnicos à equipe na solução de incidentes críticos;
  • Elaborar relatórios de operação e apoiar processos de auditoria.

Requisitos obrigatórios

O profissional deverá possuir curso superior completo na área de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) , ou curso superior completo em qualquer área , desde que complementado com pós-graduação na área de TI , realizada em instituição reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC).

São exigidas as seguintes certificações e formações complementares:

  • Certificação ISO/IEC 27001 ;
  • Certificação ITIL 4 , sendo exigido, no mínimo, o módulo Specialist – Create, Deliver & Support , ou certificação equivalente ou superior da mesma trilha;
  • Certificação HDI – SCTL (Support Center Team Lead) ;
  • Curso de capacitação em sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux .

Além da formação e certificações, o profissional deve comprovar:

  • Experiência mínima de 5 (cinco) anos em atividades técnicas relacionadas à área de TI;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 (três) anos em gestão de projetos e liderança de equipes técnicas .

Adicionalmente, é obrigatória a apresentação de ao menos uma das seguintes certificações reconhecidas na área de gerenciamento de projetos e/ou serviços de TI :

  • PMP – Project Management Professional ;
  • CAPM – Certified Associate in Project Management
