title: Unit Chief for the Amazonia Forever Regional Program
description:
Overview

This is an international staff role based at our Headquarters in Washington, D.C. We offer visa and relocation support.

We improve lives

The IDB Group is a community of diverse, versatile, and passionate people who come together on a journey to improve lives in Latin America and the Caribbean. Our people find purpose and do what they love in an inclusive, collaborative, agile, and rewarding environment.

About This Position

The Amazonia Forever Unit has rapidly positioned itself as a strategic leader in advancing sustainable development across the Amazonia region. In just three years, it has mobilized over $4.2 billion in operations across eight countries, launched innovative financing mechanisms, including Indigenous-led funds. Coordinated the first loans under the Green Climate Fund and the Amazon Bioeconomy and Forest Management Fund. Through regional networks, knowledge platforms, and global partnerships, the Unit has strengthened institutional capacities, promoted inclusive growth, and elevated the IDB’s leadership in Amazonia-related development.

We are seeking a strategic leader to serve as Unit Chief for the Amazonia Forever Regional Program. This role is central to advancing sustainable and inclusive development across the Amazonia region, which is home to nearly 40% of South America’s landmass. The Unit Chief will lead cross-sectoral efforts, manage funding mechanisms, and coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure impactful and cohesive development strategies.

This position will report to the Manager of the Southern Cone Department. It will advise and support the Vice Presidency of Countries and Regional Integration, as well as the CSC, CAN, and CCB Managers, in the preparation, development, and implementation of national and regional dialogues, strategies, and activities related to the Amazonia Forever Program.

What you’ll do

As Unit Chief, you will lead and manage the Amazonia Forever Regional Program within the Bank and its funding mechanisms and coordinate the external partners and networks that are part of the Program.

Regional Dialogues & Country Engagement

  • Coordinate high-level dialogues across Amazonia-region countries, in close collaboration with Country Representatives, to identify shared priorities and build consensus around strategic development goals.
  • Align Amazonia Forever Program goals with Country Strategies, ensuring coherence across sectors and countries.
  • Engage diverse partners and stakeholders to shape initiatives within the Amazonia Forever Program.

Operational Strategy & Policy Development

  • Advise senior management on the formulation of operational strategies, policies, and guidelines tailored to the Amazonia region.
  • Promote implementation of the program’s five key pillars:
  • Combating deforestation and strengthening environmental control and security.
  • Bioeconomy and creative economy.
  • People-centered development.
  • Sustainable cities, infrastructure, and connectivity.
  • Sustainable, low-carbon agriculture, livestock, and forestry.
  • Integrate cross-cutting themes: inclusion of women, Indigenous peoples, Afro-descendants, and local communities; climate, biodiversity, and forest conservation; and institutional capacity and rule of law.

Financing And Resource Mobilization

  • Collaborate with the IDB Global Partnerships Department to mobilize resources from donors and partners.
  • Coordinate and manage various funding mechanisms, including donor resources and IDB’s own funds.
  • Leverage Amazonia Forever’s financial instruments to support strategic solutions for regional development challenges.

Stakeholder Engagement & Community Dialogues

  • Coordinate inclusive engagement with civil society, indigenous and Afro-descendant communities, and traditional Amazonian populations in collaboration with IDB Civil Society Unit.
  • Strengthening partnerships with national and international organizations, donors, and private sector actors.

Knowledge & Innovation Agenda

  • Lead the knowledge and innovation agenda of the Amazonia Forever Program, working in close coordination with the Southern Cone, Andean, and Caribbean Departments to ensure regional integration and strategic alignment.
  • Promote experimental programs and pioneering research to support sustainable development.
  • Oversee development and dissemination of knowledge products aligned with program priorities.

Institutional Partnerships & External Representation

  • Coordinate joint initiatives with IDB Invest and IDB Lab.
  • Ensure integration of cross-cutting themes such as climate resilience, sustainability, and social inclusion within IDB Group.
  • Represent the IDB in global forums and multilateral platforms to promote the Bank’s leadership in Amazonia-related development.
  • Build and strengthen partnerships with other MDBs, international agencies, and private sector actors to support coordinated regional efforts.

What you'll need

  • Education: You hold an advanced degree (master’s or equivalent) from an accredited university in a field of the social sciences or humanities that is relevant to sustainable and inclusive development.
  • Experience: Experience related to advancing sustainable and/or inclusive development in the region.
  • Languages: Proficiency in English, and Spanish or Portuguese.

Professional Experience

  • You have extensive experience conducting strategic-level technical dialogues with diverse groups (e.g. public sector, private sector, civil society, Indigenous and/or traditional communities), including dialogues in matters related to your work.
  • Experience facilitating dialogues and negotiations that directly involved more than one country is a plus.
  • You have experience in connecting strategic-level discussions with realities at the operational level.
  • A working understanding of multi-lateral development banks is advantageous.
  • You have demonstrated understanding of the fundamental economic, socio-cultural, and environmental characteristics of the Amazonian territories within the countries that are the focus of the Amazonia Forever Regional Program.

Requirements

  • Citizenship: You are a citizen of one of our 48-member countries. We may offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Consanguinity: You have no family members (up to the fourth degree of consanguinity and second degree of affinity, including spouse) working at the IDB, IDB Invest, or IDB Lab.

Type of contract and duration

  • Staff: International staff contract, 36 months initially, renewable upon mutual agreement.

What we offer

The IDB group provides benefits that respond to the different needs and moments of an employee's life. These benefits include:

  • A competitive compensation package, including an annual base salary expressed on a net-of-tax basis.
  • Leaves and vacations: 24 days of paid time off + 8 personal days + sick leave + gender-neutral parental leave.
  • Health Insurance: IDB Group provides employees and eligible dependents with a robust medical benefits program that covers medical, dental, vision, preventive care, and prescription drugs.
  • Pension plan: a defined benefit pension plan that provides financial security and supports employees in planning for their future.
  • We offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your family when it applies.
  • Hybrid and flexible work schedules.
  • Health and well-being: Access to our Health Services Center, which provides preventive care and health education for employees.
  • Development support: We offer tools to boost your professional profile, such as mentoring, 1:1 professional counseling, training and learning opportunities, language classes, mobility options, among others.

Our culture

At the IDB, we work so everyone brings their best and authentic selves to work while finding their purpose. Our people consistently strive for excellence, and we recognize and celebrate the impact of their contributions.

In our efforts to drive innovation, we intentionally include all voices, cultivate a sense of belonging and champion fairness. We welcome individuals from underrepresented groups to join us and share their unique perspectives.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job interview process. If you require an accommodation to complete this application, please email us at

description:
Overview

SOBRE A CAPCO
Capco é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia. Somos apaixonados por ajudar nossos clientes e temos 33 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico. Se criatividade e inovação são a sua paixão, a Capco é ideal para você. Vamos te apoiar e ajudar a acelerar sua carreira!

Estamos à procura de um(a) desenvolvedor(a) altamente habilidoso e apaixonado por tecnologia para integrar nossa equipe de desenvolvimento. Como desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack , você terá um papel fundamental na criação e manutenção de sistemas robustos, escaláveis e eficientes que suportam nossos processos de ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) e integração de dados. Você trabalhará com tecnologias modernas, incluindo Java e React.js, NoSQL (MongoDB), arquitetura baseada em eventos e ferramentas de observabilidade para garantir que nosso sistema seja altamente observável e fácil de depurar.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter serviços e APIs back end e front end que suportem os processos de ETL e integração de dados (Java e React.js).
  • Implementar soluções de armazenamento de dados NoSQL, como MongoDB, para armazenar e consultar dados de forma eficaz.
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de integração baseados em eventos para facilitar a comunicação entre os diferentes componentes do sistema.
  • Trabalhar com protocolos FTP e lidar com arquivos posicionais para a troca de dados com parceiros externos.
  • Garantir que o sistema de ETL seja altamente observável, permitindo a fácil depuração de problemas e a monitoração de desempenho.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos e garantir que as soluções desenvolvidas atendam às necessidades de negócios.
  • Realizar testes de unidade, integração e aceitação para garantir a qualidade do código.
  • Manter a documentação técnica atualizada e participar na revisão de código.
  • Ficar atualizado com as melhores práticas e tendências em desenvolvimento back end e front end.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento back-end e front end, em um ambiente de microserviços com Linguagem Java, Spring Boot, React.js.
  • Conhecimento sólido em NoSQL, com experiência prática em MongoDB.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas ETL.
  • Experiência com Cloud (AWS, Azure).
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura baseada em eventos e ferramentas relacionadas.
  • Conhecimento em protocolos FTP e manipulação de arquivos posicionais.
  • Habilidade de escrever código limpo, escalável e de fácil manutenção.
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área relacionada.
  • Inglês avançado (atuará em time internacional).

Por Que Capco

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões. Pensamos, em conjunto, ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social através de comitês internos geridos pela nossa comunidade interna, como grupos de Mulheres, Pessoas com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAPN+, Parentalidade, Gerações, entre outros. Nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas para todos(as)!!!

title: Supervisor de Unidade
description:
Overview

Job type: Full-time employee

Se o seu propósito é inspirar pessoas a cuidar de pessoas, você está no lugar certo!

Fundado em Brasília pelas bioquímicas Janete Vaz e Sandra Soares Costa, o Grupo Sabin está há 38 anos no mercado. Somos referência em Medicina Diagnóstica, com atuação em análises clínicas, diagnóstico por imagem, vacinação e check-up executivo. O Sabin também atua em Atenção Primária à Saúde (APS) com a Amparo Saúde e lançou, no ano passado, a plataforma integradora de serviços de saúde Rita Saúde. Somos reconhecidos no Brasil e na América Latina como uma das melhores empresas para trabalhar há mais de 18 anos, com cultura organizacional forte, respeito, desenvolvimento, diversidade e inclusão. Contamos com mais de 6.700 colaboradores, em 12 estados e no Distrito Federal, com 323 unidades.

Responsibilities

  • Planejar e administrar o trabalho da equipe, definindo rotinas, técnicas de abordagem de clientes e estratégias para cumprir metas e prazos;
  • Supervisionar todas as rotinas administrativas da equipe;
  • Supervisionar serviços gerais de malotes, mensageiros, transporte, limpeza, terceirizados, manutenção de equipamento, mobiliário e instalações;
  • Responder pelas metas e resultados da equipe, traçando planos de avanço e de melhoria contínua;
  • Monitorar os indicadores da área;
  • Planejar e desenvolver novos projetos, quando aplicável;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento, informações e metas com toda a equipe;
  • Controlar as atividades financeiras das unidades;
  • Manter relacionamento com clientes, mercado e médicos;
  • Realizar mapeamento de mercado local e fechar parcerias para captação e fidelização de clientes;
  • Gerenciar o clima organizacional, proporcionando um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo;
  • Promover feedbacks de forma respeitosa;
  • Sinalizar casos de baixa performance à gestão de pessoal;
  • Realizar desligamentos junto ao RH, quando aplicável;
  • Assegurar que as políticas e normas da empresa sejam cumpridas pela equipe;
  • Desenvolver novos лидеры quando aplicável;
  • Propor ações de melhoria contínua;

Qualifications

  • Graduação completa em Biomedicina, Enfermagem, Farmácia ou áreas correlatas da Saúde;
  • Desejável especialização em Gestão em Saúde, Administração Hospitalar ou áreas afins;
  • Conhecimento em Boas Práticas Laboratoriais, biossegurança e protocolos de qualidade;
  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos em cargos de liderança em serviços de saúde;
  • Experiência na implementação de processos, protocolos de qualidade e auditorias;
  • Curso de Auditor PALC será um diferencial;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado será considerado um diferencial;
  • Etapas do processo seletivo incluem entrevista com o gestor.

About Sabin

Referência em saúde, destacada pela gestão de pessoas e liderança feminina, o Grupo Sabin nasceu em Brasília há décadas, fruto da coragem de duas empreendedoras. Hoje, conta com cerca de 7.000 colaboradores, presente em 14 estados e no Distrito Federal, com 354 unidades, oferecendo serviços de saúde com excelência, inovação e responsabilidade socioambiental. O ecossistema de saúde do Grupo Sabin integra análises clínicas, diagnóstico por imagem, anatomia patológica, genômica, imunização e check-up executivo, além de serviços de atenção primária com a Amparo Saúde e a plataforma Rita Saúde, promovendo acesso à saúde com qualidade e eficiência. Em 2020, foi lançado o SkyHub.Bio, hub de inovação para promoção e desenvolvimento de startups na saúde. O Grupo mantém o Instituto Sabin, criado em 2005 para ações de impacto social, que já beneficiou mais de 1,6 milhão de pessoas e 902 organizações sociais.

Conheça nossos processos seletivos e vagas disponíveis nas unidades Sabin pelo Brasil. Investimos em processos formulados para atrair pessoas engajadas com nosso propósito e valores.

Fique atento e evite golpes! Não cobramos quaisquer valores para participação em nossos processos seletivos em qualquer etapa.

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

Overview

Runware is building a leading API for all AI. Our platform makes it easy for developers to add advanced media generation capabilities to their products in hours instead of months, without the burden of managing GPUs, scaling, or constant model updates. By combining custom hardware with optimized software and orchestration, we deliver unmatched speed, reliability, and cost efficiency across hundreds of thousands of models. Backed by top global investors, we're growing quickly and building a team to shape the future of AI development.

About The Role
We\'re looking for Developer Relations to be the technical voice connecting our media generation API with the developer community. You\'ll bridge the gap between our engineering team and the developers building on Runware—from indie creators to enterprise teams integrating our generation capabilities into their products.

First and foremost, you must be passionate about generative AI and able to demonstrate it through project links, technical content, open-source contributions, or other hands-on work. We\'re looking for builders with some development experience. You don\'t need to be a superstar engineer, but you should be comfortable writing and debugging code.

This is an intentionally broad role that will flex around your strengths. It could include creating educational content, debugging integrations, supporting developers, building SDKs and integrations, or representing Runware at events and hackathons. You might maintain SDKs or third-party integrations, build new integrations, or contribute workflow examples and tutorials. A key part of the role is bringing value to our ecosystem which could include being active in public — sharing your work, engaging with other developers, and making technical content visible across socials, forums, and communities. You\'ll help Runware have a strong presence where developers already are.

More than just a job title, this is an invitation to join a company that\'s spearheading the future of AI. We\'re looking for people who want to partner with us, explore their passion for AI, and help other developers succeed. Your technical credibility with developers matters most. Everything else is flexible.

Is this role a fit for you?

If you\'re unsure whether you tick every box below but you\'re excited by AI and have something to show, we\'d love to hear from you. This role is designed to flex around the right people. If you\'ve built projects, contributed to communities, or simply can\'t stop experimenting with generative AI, you already have what matters most. Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)

Overview

We are building a differentiated brand in a competitive AI/SaaS market. This is a part-time freelance role with a clear path to a full-time position within 12 months based on impact. You will report to the Founder/Marketing/Head of Design and work with Growth, Product, Marketing, and Founders to ship work that moves metrics.

What You'll Do

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end-to-end: insight → moodboard → concept → production → iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 hours for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands-on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in-house).
  • You know category patterns and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste with refined typography, layout discipline, and strategic restraint where it matters.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; you have references at your fingertips.
  • Not afraid to be bold; you can defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast-paced, passionate, easy to work with; low-ego collaborator who communicates crisply.
  • Tools: Figma & WordPress / Elemento power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed.
  • Bonus: light motion (After Effects, or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points

  • 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Ability to produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understanding of performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat in up to 12 months based on results.
  • Ship work seen by millions, not buried in decks.
  • Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

What to Include

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work).
  • For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal → your role → outcome (metrics if possible).
  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets).
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

title: Commission Analyst
description:
Overview

TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you\'ll join a mission-driven, fast-paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily. Whether analyzing blockchain data, developing cutting-edge tools, or collaborating with global organizations, you\'ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

We are seeking a Commissions Analyst to ensure accuracy, responsiveness, and scalability in how commissions and revenue operations are managed in a dynamic, high-growth environment with multiple commission plans, frequent changes, and evolving billing needs.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, has a meticulous eye for detail, and is energized by building efficient processes that reduce risk and improve visibility. You’ll work cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, and Operations teams to deliver timely and accurate commissions, resolve system issues, and implement process improvements that scale with the business. This role is critical to ensuring commissions are paid correctly and on time, while also strengthening revenue recognition and reporting processes.

Responsibilities

  • Accurate and reliable commissions: Ensure commission processes are managed with precision, supporting timely and error-free payouts that build trust across the sales organization.
  • Clear visibility into revenue operations: Strengthen reporting and data integrity in Spiff, Salesforce, and billing systems, enabling leadership to make confident, data-driven decisions.
  • Proactive issue resolution: Help surface and address discrepancies in opportunities, contracts, or commission data early, minimizing downstream risks and delays.
  • Scalable processes and automation: Contribute to the design of workflows and reporting that reduce manual effort, improve transparency, and adapt as the business grows.
  • Cross-functional alignment: Build strong relationships with Sales, Finance, and Operations by serving as a reliable partner and trusted resource on commissions and revenue reporting.

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years of experience in revenue operations, commissions administration, or related finance roles, ideally in a SaaS or high-growth environment.
  • Strong technical proficiency with commissions tools (Spiff preferred), Salesforce CRM, and billing/AR platforms, with the ability to implement changes and troubleshoot independently.
  • Background in accounting operations (billing, invoicing, AR, or contract review) that strengthens commission accuracy and revenue reporting.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, paired with an ownership mindset and ability to manage 3–4 concurrent projects without delays.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in reconciliations, variance analysis, and supporting ASC 340-40 compliance.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who provides fast, reliable support to cross-functional stakeholders.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We know a lot of startups say that, but we mean it. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you\'ll be joining a team that\'s highly engaged, mission-driven, and constantly evolving. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full-time employees. TRM may not be the right fit for everyone. If you\'re optimizing for work-life balance, we encourage you to ask about balance within teams and reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high-velocity environment.

The Stakes Are Real: Our work has direct, real-world impact, including supporting urgent government requests, terrorist financing investigations, and global security efforts. We also build new processes quickly to stop criminals before they cash out and analyze blockchain data to recover stolen savings.

Life at TRM

As a remote-first company, TRM is built for global collaboration. We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication and meaningful relationships, invest in offsites and onboarding buddies, and prioritize trust and belonging.

Join our mission. We\'re looking for team members who thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and love building from the ground up. If you’re excited about TRM\'s mission, we want to hear from you. TRM is remote-first, with a globally distributed team.

Recruitment agencies: TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. TRM Labs is not responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes without a signed agreement. Privacy Policy: By submitting your application, you are agreeing to allow TRM to process your personal information in accordance with the TRM Privacy Policy.

title: Staff Software Engineer  (Fraud team)
description:
At Félix, we're building the financial ecosystem for Latin immigrants in the U.S., starting with a revolution in remittances. Our core product is an AI-powered chatbot built on WhatsApp, allowing our users to send money home as easily as sending a text message. We leverage cutting-edge technology like AI, blockchain, and stablecoins to make cross-border payments faster, more affordable, and more accessible than ever before.

We are a hyper-growth Series B company, backed by over $100 million in funding from top-tier global investors. Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long.

About The Role

Join Félix as a Staff Software Engineer on our dedicated Fraud team, where you'll play a pivotal role in building and enhancing our defenses against financial crime. This position demands a blend of deep technical expertise and a keen understanding of fraud typologies. You will be responsible for architecting and implementing advanced, data-driven systems that proactively identify and mitigate risks across our platform.

title: Senior Data Scientist | BEES Personalization
description:
Remoto

About BEES

BEES, our ambition is – and always will be – to put customers at the heart of everything we do. Making their lives easier and their businesses more profitable. Through our B2B e-commerce and SaaS platform, we bring the power of digital to small and medium-sized retailers and the companies that service them, unlocking new growth opportunities for all. With offices in São Paulo and Campinas, we encourage our team to participate in major events and significant meetings throughout the year.

The Team: BEES is the team driving AI strategy at BEES by building end-to-end products to serve our teams, customers, and partners across the globe. The organization is a cross-functional blend of AI/ML teams from Applied Research and Machine Learning Engineering to Machine Learning Platform Product Management. Together, the team is responsible for building the tools and products needed to deliver world-class AI/ML capabilities

As a member of BEES Applied Science team, you will develop solutions for challenging business problems in areas such as portfolio optimization, recommendations, personalization, promos, segmentation, imputation, and insights discovery. The ideal candidate should hold a bachelor's degree in any quantitative field; strong mastery of frontier algorithms in machine and deep learning; plus working knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, Databricks) for ML applications. Proficiency in python / pyspark programming, collaboration tools, and working knowledge of CI/CD tools like GitHub is required. Knowledge of workflows for automation is also required.

What you will do:

  • Collaborate on the design of complex analysis of datasets and the development and deployment of advanced machine learning and deep learning algorithms for portfolio optimization, recommendations, personalization, promos, segmentation, imputation, and insight discovery. Ensure that solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned with business objectives while mentoring junior and mid-level data scientists.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or any quantitative field; Master’s or PhD strongly preferred.

  • Good knowledge of CI/CD tools like Github for version control and collaboration. Familiarity with other collaboration tools is a plus.
  • Understanding of workflows and automation tools to streamline processes and enhance efficiency.

title: Senior AI Software Engineer
description:
Workana is the largest remote work platform for talents in Latin America. Our new segment, Workana Premium , focuses on matching the most exceptional professionals with leading and innovative companies around the globe. Enjoy competitive compensation, dedicated support, and the flexibility of remote work within a dynamic environment that fosters collaboration and professional advancement.

We are proud to present you with the following opportunity.

About Our Client

Our client is a family-owned legal services business undergoing a major transformation to scale their operations through advanced AI and software solutions. They are building the future of their industry by automating workflows, enhancing efficiency, and creating AI-powered products that redefine how legal services are delivered.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to join the team and lead the development of cutting-edge agentic orchestration systems. This role will focus on two key initiatives:

  • SaaS Conversion - Transforming the company's existing AI-driven report generation framework into a scalable SaaS product.
  • Deposition Agent System - Building and orchestrating a new AI agent workflow to automate deposition preparation, integrating diverse data sources and leveraging Model Context Protocol (MCP).

The ideal candidate is an experienced AI engineer with strong integration skills, Python expertise, and hands-on knowledge of agentic orchestration and MCP. You will collaborate directly with the CTO, execute autonomously, and potentially mentor junior engineers as the team expands.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement agentic orchestration workflows, including Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication and self-reinforcement learning.
  • Lead the SaaS conversion of the company's existing AI-based product, ensuring scalability, security, and reliability.
  • Build the Deposition Agent System, integrating APIs and data pipelines (email, CRM, file systems) into LLM-powered agents.
  • Work with Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect and contextualize data across multiple systems.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI frameworks (e.g., N8N, CrewAI, or alternatives) to optimize agent performance.
  • Collaborate with the CTO and stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship as the AI team grows.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in AI/ML or agent-based systems.
  • Proven experience with agentic orchestration, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Protocols (hands-on preferred, theoretical knowledge acceptable).
  • Strong coding skills in Python, with the ability to leverage "vibe coding" tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) for rapid development.
  • Experience with API integrations, data pipelines, and connecting multi-system environments.
  • Understanding of SaaS product architecture and deployment.
  • Ability to work autonomously while following high-level direction from the CTO.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and adaptability to emerging AI technologies.

Benefits

  • Compensation in USD.
  • Fully remote work in Latin America.
  • Career growth opportunities with international projects and innovative AI-driven initiatives.

description:
Horário: REGIME PJ, HORÁRIO COMERCIAL

Contratação: Service provider - legal entity

Nível: Operational

Descrição e Responsabilidades

Como SDR (Sales Development Representative), sua principal missão será identificar e qualificar potenciais clientes brasileiros que vivem no exterior e demonstram interesse em investimentos. Atuamos com uma abordagem de venda passiva, ou seja, os leads já demonstraram algum nível de interesse ou chegaram até nós por canais de atração.

Você será responsável por entender o perfil e as necessidades desses leads, fazer os primeiros contatos, nutrir o relacionamento e encaminhá-los para nossos closers, que finalizam a venda de forma consultiva.

Buscamos alguém com boa comunicação, organização e sede por crescimento, com foco claro em evoluir para a cadeira de Closer em um curto/médio prazo.

Requisitos

Obrigatórios

  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Habilidade para se conectar com pessoas e entender suas necessidades;
  • Perfil persuasivo e boa escuta ativa;
  • Experiência prévia com vendas, atendimento comercial ou pré-vendas (mesmo que em outros segmentos);
  • Vontade real de crescer profissionalmente, com foco em se tornar Closer em curto/médio prazo;
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads e seguir processos de qualificação.


Desejáveis (diferenciais)

  • Experiência com vendas no mercado financeiro, investimentos ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Familiaridade com o público brasileiro no exterior (expatriados ou investidores internacionais);
  • Experiência como corretor de imóveis, agente autônomo ou vendedor consultivo;
  • Conhecimento básico de funil de vendas, CRM e metas comerciais.


Benefícios: Ajuda de custo, Bônus por resultado, Comissões, Gympass

description:
Psicólogos (as) Wellz | Inscrição 10/2025

Join to apply for the Psicólogos (as) Wellz | Inscrição 10/2025 role at Wellz by Wellhub

Sobre o Wellz

Em 2021, o Wellhub fundou o Wellz com o objetivo de democratizar a saúde mental no Brasil. Possibilitamos que empresas ajudem suas equipes a serem mais saudáveis, mais resilientes e mais profundamente engajadas. Através da nossa plataforma, é possível realizar atendimento clínico individual online, acessar conteúdos interativos sobre saúde mental e participar de rodas de conversa em grupo.

Facilitamos o acesso das pessoas a uma jornada de autocuidado e autoconhecimento que seja ideal para as suas necessidades individuais. A abordagem que utilizamos é a Terapia Cognitivo Comportamental, com intervenções voltadas para a melhora clínica individual e baseadas em evidências.

A oportunidade

O Wellz está crescendo e, por isso, estamos procurando psicólogos e psicólogas com experiência clínica para fazer parte da nossa comunidade. Você receberá pacientes, realizará sessões de psicoterapia, terá acesso a supervisão gratuita e fará parte de uma inovadora solução de cuidado à saúde mental.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Psicologia;
  • Especialização ou pós graduação completa em Terapia Cognitivo Comportamental;
  • Experiência prévia realizando psicoterapia on-line individual;
  • Inscrição ativa no Conselho Regional de Psicologia (CRP);
  • Habilidades para conduzir atendimentos de forma online;
  • Possuir computador para realização de atendimento clínico, assim como outros equipamentos que garantam a qualidade do atendimento;
  • Ter empresa aberta, cuja atividade seja compatível com serviços psicológicos.

Por que fazer parte do time de parceiros do Wellz?

  • Nova fonte de renda, sem custo extra para se juntar à nossa rede;
  • Acesso a novos pacientes, trazidos diretamente até você;
  • Flexibilidade de horário, com a possibilidade de criar a sua própria agenda;
  • Metodologia comprovada, baseada em dados e tecnologia;
  • Comunidade de terapeutas para dividir aprendizados e melhores práticas;
  • Supervisão clínica sem custo e com orientação direcionada;
  • Acesso ao Wellhub para cuidar da sua saúde de forma integral.

O Wellz é para todas as pessoas, independente da religião, orientação sexual, etnia, gênero e outros. Se você preenche os requisitos necessários, se inscreva e venha fazer parte dessa rede que só cresce!

  • Essa oportunidade é referente a uma parceria de prestação de serviços e, dessa forma, não configura vínculo empregatício.

title: Supervisor (a) UTD (Unidade Distribuição - Salvador/BA)
description:
Supervisor (a) UTD (Unidade Distribuição - Salvador/BA)

Join to apply for the Supervisor (a) UTD (Unidade Distribuição - Salvador/BA) role at Neoenergia

Somos um time de 16 mil colaboradores próprios, espalhados por 18 estados brasileiros e no Distrito Federal. Aqui, os sotaques se misturam, integração, colaboração e segurança são elementos fundamentais em nosso dia a dia. Atuamos em toda a cadeia do setor elétrico brasileiro, Geração, Transmissão, Distribuição e Comercialização. Juntos, somos essa Neoenergia toda!

Queremos liderar a transição energética no Brasil e ser a escolha número 1 para brasileiros e brasileiras. E faremos isso com pessoas de todos os gêneros, raças, idades, orientações sexuais e com deficiências. Investimos em diversidade, inovação e tecnologias para oferecer a melhor experiência de soluções energéticas conectadas a cada um dos nossos 16 milhões de clientes!

Sua energia será muito importante para:

Ser responsável pelo controle e gestão manutenção preventiva e corretiva do sistema de distribuição, execução do plano de combate a perdas, plano de combate a inadimplência, ligação de clientes, obedecendo aos critérios de segurança, para que os investimentos sejam devidamente remunerados pelo órgão regulador, atendendo os índices de qualidade e prazos regulatórios, buscando a melhoria dos processos, o aperfeiçoamento tecnológico e redução dos custos, através do desenvolvimento e conexão com o time direto e indireto (gestão de pessoas) da UTD Pirajá e/ou Graça.

Atividades:

  • Contribuir para melhoria dos índices de continuidade do fornecimento de energia elétrica através da manutenção corretiva da rede de distribuição e da execução das ações de manutenção preventiva decorrentes das inspeções dos objetos técnicos da rede de distribuição.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria da qualidade do fornecimento de energia elétrica por meio do controle dos atendimentos de nível de tensão.
  • Gerir os processos comerciais em relação à execução em campo dos serviços de novas ligações e ações de combate às perdas e inadimplência.
  • Controlar e otimizar os orçamentos de CAPEX e OPEX disponibilizados para a unidade, garantindo a aplicação prudente dos recursos;
  • Realizar a gestão dos colaboradores por meio de controle e estruturação de atividades, avaliação contínua de desempenho, ações de desenvolvimento e implementação e manutenção de um bom ambiente organizacional;
  • Apoiar nas tratativas com as áreas de conexão;
  • Liderar a cultura de aumento de eficiência e produtividade dos recursos disponíveis por meio da gestão da análise de desempenho, aprimoramento tecnológico, desenvolvimento e treinamento dos colaboradores envolvidos e reconhecimento das melhores práticas;
  • Promover a disseminação das informações, mensagens e campanhas do Grupo Neoenergia para todos os colaboradores da Unidade, utilizando uma linguagem adequada para o público alvo e seguindo a política de comunicação corporativa;
  • Representar a Neoenergia perante o público externo, respeitando as diretrizes e orientações do Grupo;
  • Prezar pelos valores de Saúde, Segurança, Sustentabilidade, e Meio Ambiente disseminados pela companhia por meio de campanhas e políticas, aplicando seus princípios em todas as ações, processos e diretrizes da empresa.

Para fazer parte do nosso time, você precisa ter:

  • Formação superior completa, preferencialmente, em Engenharia Elétrica;
  • Vivência em operação e manutenção no setor elétrico (preferencialmente em distribuição de energia);
  • Habilitação categoria B vigente;
  • Pacote office intermediário;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar e residir em Salvador/BA e atuar nas unidades de Pirajá e/ou Graça ;
  • Vivência em liderança de times diretos ou indiretos;
  • Vivência em gestão de processos.

Para você ficar com a energia lá em cima, confira nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico para cuidar de você e de seus dependentes.
  • Vale Alimentação para fazer aquele mercado reforçado ou Vale Refeição para confraternizar com os colegas no horário de almoço;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados da empresa, o momento mais esperado do ano!;
  • Licença maternidade estendida, para um puerpério com mais tranquilidade;
  • Licença paternidade, para ficar bem perto da sua família nos primeiros dias do bebê;
  • Licença para casais homoafetivos, porque aqui reconhecemos todos os tipos de família;
  • Gympass para você fazer atividade física e ficar cheio de energia;
  • Programa de Idiomas para você poder se aperfeiçoar em outro idioma;
  • Auxílio Creche para te apoiar com o cuidado dos seus filhos;
  • Previdência Privada para você ter um futuro mais tranquilo;
  • Seguro de Vida para apoiar nossos colaboradores em todos os momentos.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Nosso time de Engenharia

Em nossa equipe de engenharia utilizamos tecnologias modernas, soluções inovadoras, agilidade e buscamos práticas de desenvolvimento de software que entregue soluções técnicas de qualidade aos nossos produtos e agregue o maior impacto na vida de milhares de empreendedores.

Como Software Engineering Manager, você vai liderar uma equipe de engenharia de software, apoiar o crescimento dela e ser quem impulsiona a mudança e a melhoria contínua da companhia. É quem conecta as pessoas de sua equipe com a missão da Nuvemshop.

O tamanho do seu desafio

  • Ser referência técnica e contribuir com o desenho e desenvolvimento arquitetônico de soluções, tomando decisões;
  • Ser hands on e estar a frente no desenvolvimento com a equipe;
  • Liderar, motivar e empoderar o crescimento e a evolução profissional da equipe de engenharia através de feedbacks e desenvolvimento de planos de carreira;
  • Atuar em parceria com o time de produto e design na construção e na condução do roadmap de desenvolvimento e nas definições de features;
  • Garantir uma comunicação clara e fluída entre as diferentes áreas;
  • Promover as melhores práticas de engenharia e arquitetura de software, aplicando abordagem de testes unitários e entrega contínua;
  • Reduzir dívidas técnicas da equipe e garantir a robustez, resiliência e escalabilidade da plataforma.

O que buscamos

  • Experiência liderando e potencializando equipes de engenharia de software de alto desempenho;
  • Experiência trabalhando em sistemas robustos e complexos que atendem a um grande volume de tráfego;
  • Experiência com metodologías ágiles;
  • Background técnico e experiência com desenvolvimento de produto;
  • Experiência trabalhando com arquitetura de microsserviços e novas tecnologias.

Nosso processo

Queremos que você tenha a melhor experiência possível ao longo do nosso processo seletivo. Após a sua inscrição, o time de Talent Acquisition irá analisar seu perfil com atenção e, independentemente do resultado, você receberá um retorno. As etapas e prazos podem variar de acordo com cada vaga, mas não se preocupe — que nos manteremos em contato com você.

O que temos para você

  • Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  • Flash Benefícios: Plataforma que reúne vale alimentação, vale refeição e outras categorias como educação, entretenimento, cultura, saúde, bem-estar, auxílio home office e muito mais;
  • Aulas de espanhol semanais gratuitas;
  • Totalpass: As melhores redes de parcerias para atividades físicas, mindfulness, terapia, nutrição e qualidade do sono, com diversos planos disponíveis;
  • Descontos nos cursos da Coderhouse;
  • Auxílio creche para crianças de até 5 anos;
  • Licença de família estendida para 21 dias corridos para pessoas não grávidas ou adotantes. A licença maternidade é de 4 meses e a licença parental de 21 dias. O benefício também vale para famílias que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homoafetivos;
  • Além das férias, temos uma semana de descanso para recarregar as energias no final/começo do ano;
  • Uma Nuvemshop gratuita para você ou pessoa próxima;
  • Somos #remotefirst - o que significa que damos prioridade ao trabalho remoto dentro do país de contratação, sempre que a função permitir;
  • E um ambiente de desafio contínuo, propósito e protagonismo — aqui você é livre para pensar grande e ter atitude gigante.

Política de Privacidade de Dados

A Nuvemshop está comprometida em proteger a privacidade e garantir a segurança dos dados pessoais das pessoas candidatas às vagas que ofertamos.

Para dar seguimento com a sua candidatura, teremos acesso a alguns dados pessoais seus e gostaríamos de repassar algumas informações antes de você continuar. Utilizaremos tais dados para conduzirmos os processos que envolvem o recrutamento e a seleção. Além disso, cuidamos dos seus dados pessoais de forma muita séria e só os compartilhamos com quem realmente precisa. Por fim, somente iremos mantê-los em nosso sistema pelo tempo realmente necessário.

Para saber mais sobre a forma pela qual tratamos seus dados, inclusive dos seus direitos previstos em lei, basta acessar a nossa Política de Privacidade.

description:
Superside is looking for a Post Production Producer to help rethink how video gets made at scale.

In this role, you’ll design and lead workflows that combine creativity with automation, ensuring content can be localized, personalized, and delivered faster without sacrificing quality.

You’ll collaborate with creative, ops, and tech teams to push the boundaries of post-production—driving efficiency, profitability, and impact for some of the world’s top brands.

What You'll Do

  • Lead workflow optimization for editing at scale in post-production.
  • Drive localization and personalization projects using automation and AI-driven tools like Figma and StoryTeq.
  • Oversee production projects (video, motion, 3D, AR) from brief to delivery, ensuring quality and efficiency.
  • Partner with Creative Project Managers, Creative Directors, and Finance, as well as direct customer stakeholders.
  • Manage scope, planning, ingestion, and post-production workflows across teams.
  • Improve processes and establish scalable ways of working.
  • Own project profitability by managing budgets, timelines, and deliverables.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • 5+ years of experience in creative production (agency, in-house, or production company).
  • Strong background in post-production at scale, especially for digital-first content.
  • Proven ability to structure processes and improve operational efficiency.
  • Curiosity about AI, AR, and emerging creative tools, with experience applying them to production workflows.
  • Track record running or contributing to AI-first creative projects.
  • Comfortable working in a global, remote-first, asynchronous environment.
  • Ability to collaborate across time zones and adapt to fast-changing priorities.
  • Strong communication skills to align teams, understand briefs, and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Bonus: Experience working with performance marketing teams and optimizing content for testing and iteration.

Superside is trusted by 450+ ambitious brands and is the #1 creative-as-a-subscription service designed with Marketers and Creatives in mind.

We’re on a mission to create more equal opportunities globally. Superside is a natively remote company enabling us to attract the best talent no matter where they are.

We offer a global community of talented people working from more than 60 different countries, flexible working hours, and a fully remote setup.

Superside is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates.

With $30M+ in venture funding and solid traction, we're investing in the next generation of our platform—and we're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to help drive it.

Why This Role Rocks

  • Own What You Build - Lead projects end-to-end with full autonomy and real impact
  • Remote & Flexible - Work from anywhere and set your own hours
  • Build Meaningful Tech - Help shape the tools that thousands of homeowners and service pros rely on daily
  • Join at the Right Time - We have strong product-market fit and real momentum—you'll help define what comes next

Our Tech Stack

  • Languages & Frameworks: PHP (Laravel), JavaScript (React, React Native, Vue)
  • Cloud Services: AWS (Lambda, ECS, EKS, Aurora, Redshift)
  • Approach: We're not fixated on specific languages. If you have strong engineering fundamentals and experience with any mainstream object-oriented language, we believe you can quickly learn and adapt to our tech stack

What You'll Do

As a Senior Staff Engineer , you'll work closely with the Software Architect and other engineers to:

  • Collaborate on designing and implementing system architecture, technical strategy, and engineering standards.
  • Lead technical initiatives across teams, ensuring alignment with architectural direction and goals.
  • Build and maintain platform-level components, services, and libraries that enhance engineering efficiency and system maintainability.
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and hands-on guidance.
  • Contribute directly to both server-side and client-side development across the entire stack.
  • Write and review technical design documents, system diagrams, and reference implementations.
  • Evaluate and implement new tools, frameworks, and best practices to continuously improve our platform.
  • Enhance observability, performance, scalability, and security throughout our system.
  • Share knowledge and insights to foster team growth and improvement.

Requirements

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Experienced: A principal engineer, lead full-stack engineer, or someone with relevant experience in similar roles.
  • Highly skilled in both server-side and client-side software development.
  • Technically Proficient: Familiar with cloud development (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure).
  • Experienced with Test Driven Development (TDD), RESTful APIs, React, MVC frameworks, and security concerns (e.g., XSS attacks).
  • Fundamentally Strong in Computer Science Concepts: You can explain concepts like Big O notation, pointers, composition vs. inheritance, and data structures such as arrays, sets, and linked lists.
  • Database-Savvy: Proficient in SQL and NoSQL databases, and understand operations like CRUD, indexes, and joins.
  • Cloud Infrastructure Expert: Comfortable working with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS Lambda, ECS, EKS, Aurora) and utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IAC).
  • Customer-Centric: Passionate about clean code and building customer-driven solutions with a focus on quality and reliability

Benefits

  • Perks of Working with Us
    • Competitive contract rate
    • Work from anywhere
    • Flexible hours—get the work done on your schedule
    • High ownership and autonomy
    • Fast-moving team that loves to build, learn, and grow

Responsabilidades da Oportunidade

Se você é movido por desafios, adora desenvolver times e garantir a melhor experiência para os clientes, essa vaga é para você!

Responsabilidades:

  • Garantir a continuidade, retenção e expansão dos clientes em nossa base ativa, estruturando processos, acompanhando métricas e garantindo a melhor experiência para nossos clientes ao longo de sua jornada;
  • Supervisionar o time de Customer Success Ongoing, garantindo o atendimento das demandas e o acompanhamento proativo da carteira de clientes;
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias e processos de sucesso do cliente, com foco em retenção, expansão e satisfação;
  • Acompanhar KPIs e OKRs da área, como churn, NPS, expansão de contas (upsell/cross-sell), engajamento de clientes e saúde da carteira;
  • Atuar como elo entre o cliente e as demais áreas da empresa, trazendo feedbacks estratégicos para aprimoramento contínuo do produto, processos e serviços;
  • Realizar 1:1s com o time, fornecer treinamento e feedbacks constantes, promovendo o desenvolvimento de habilidades técnicas e comportamentais;
  • Participar da resolução de casos críticos e negociações estratégicas, apoiando o time quando necessário;
  • Garantir a execução de planos de ação para clientes em risco, focando na recuperação da saúde do cliente e na prevenção de cancelamentos;
  • Colaborar ativamente com áreas como Produto, Comercial, Suporte e Implementação;
  • Analisar dados de comportamento e uso do cliente, propondo ações preventivas e de engajamento.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Comunicação, Gestão de Processos ou áreas afins;
  • Possuir experiência em customer success, atendimento ao cliente, ou áreas correlatas, com foco em clientes B2B;
  • Experiência com liderança de times, com habilidades em gestão de pessoas, feedbacks e desenvolvimento de equipes;
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação, negociação e resolução de problemas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma estruturada, orientada a metas e dados;
  • Visão estratégica e foco em melhoria contínua de processos;
  • Foco no Cliente: na Trinks o Cliente não tem sempre razão, ele É a razão;
  • Espírito Inovador! Aqui a gente valoriza as soluções mais simples para os problemas mais complexos.

Diferenciais:

  • Vivência em empresas de Saas ou tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de expansão e account management;
  • Familiaridade com OKRs, frameworks de Customer Success como planejamento de sucesso e Health Score.

Benefícios:

  • 100% Home office;
  • Contratação CLT (40 horas semanais);
  • Auxílio home office;
  • Vale alimentação e vale refeição em cartão flexível;
  • Plano de Saúde SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);
  • Plano Odonto Bradesco (custo zero para o colaborador);
  • TotalPass (plano academia);
  • Incentivo ao Desenvolvimento: PDI, Capacitações, Feedbacks, desconto em faculdades e cursos de idiomas;
  • Bônus por indicação de talentos;
  • Day off de aniversário e tempo de casa.

Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência. Na Trinks, valorizamos a melhor versão de você mesmo, com incentivos e autonomia para trabalhar, desenvolver e implementar ideias.

title: Head of Growth Marketing
description:
Our Mission is to be able to say - “Anyone in the World below $15M should fire their Agency tomorrow as nobody can beat this Value & Service at this Price”

We’re looking for a Highly Motivated & Hard-Working Head of Growth Marketing to join the team.

As a Head of Growth Marketing, you will be at the heart of crafting data-driven forecasts and executing strategies that push our clients toward their goals. Your actions and initiatives consistently resonate with the core values of CTC Global, serving as a beacon for these principles. At CTC, your trained expertise is invaluable, covering the entire spectrum of CTC’s Strategic Forecasting methods and the foundational principles of media acquisition.

Your role extends past strategy alone, it’s also about fostering strong client relationships by clearly communicating the steps taken and how results compare to projections. This ongoing transparency builds trust and strengthens the connection between CTC and its clients, helping them navigate the nuances of media buying and long-term growth planning.

You stand as a representative and dedicated advocate for CTC's distinctive approach to media acquisition and its accompanying tools. As a Head of Growth Marketing, you are held to a high standard. People know that if you are involved, things will get accomplished.

You thrive on challenges, are committed to delivering measurable results, and take great pride in giving it your all. We embrace the mantra, 'Everyday in Everyplay, Count on Me,' meaning that you can see things through to the end!

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible Company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing Our mission, we organize all of our decisions—from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money—in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone.

They're challenging. In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

AUTODIDACT

  • Naturally curious and an autodidact, able to absorb information quickly and effectively, like osmosis. Your commitment to learning sets you apart, absorbing information swiftly and more effectively than your peers.
  • Your openness to both offer and embrace feedback as an opportunity for growth and implement it proactively, without needing constant direction.
  • Demonstrates resourcefulness, and independently refine your skills without being prompted.
  • Thrives in a self-managed environment, showing autonomy, initiative, and a commitment to continuous improvement and not requiring task lists built by their managers and constant oversight.

UNIMPEACHABLE CHARACTER

  • Embodies a character that inspires pride in both personal and professional associations.
  • Consistently honest, with the courage to acknowledge and communicate hard truths, and the humility to accept them, even when uncomfortable, and never lie in any situation.
  • Displays a high level of self-awareness, taking full ownership of outcomes without resorting to a victim mindset.
  • Values constructive feedback and integrates it, understanding nothing great is built without feedback.

COMPETITIVE GREATNESS

  • Performs at their best when it matters most, The Enjoyment of Hard Challenges.
  • Demonstrates an unyielding determination to get things done, regardless of obstacles, time constraints, skills needed, or resources.
  • Adapts to changing circumstances, recognizing that true success is about not just meeting, but exceeding what is required.
  • Possesses a deep passion for their work, using creativity and resilience to overcome any hurdle.

What Success Looks Like

NECESSARY SKILLS

KICK OFF PERIOD

  • Be willing to put in the hard work required and be hungry enough to go through the kick off.
  • Being ready and prepared for this to be the hardest job you have ever worked, as you would fundamentally develop a high-leverage new skill.
  • The ability to take feedback and implement it fast.
  • Finish the work to the fullest with quality and on time.
  • Perseverance.
  • Remember and learn from the repetitive doing of the exercises.

ONBOARDING

  • Align with the team and contribute to the team called Brain Trust for Ideas across clients.
  • Manage, align & work with the team members of your pod including Google strategist, Creative Strategist, and Email Strategist.
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks with great attention to detail.
  • Upkeep of data integrity of your clients across Statlas.
  • Be responsible for the execution of the Prophet system for your clients
  • Building a Growth Forecast for your clients
    • Building a Growth map using the Prophet System
    • Data Analysis required for the Map
    • Marketing calendar alignment and upkeep with clients
  • The Daily Execution and Actualisation vs the Forecast.
    • You make tactical deconstructions and actualize the projections each day to adjust them to meet KPIs
  • Combine data analysis and feedback from clients to develop strategic plans for the future.
  • When it’s time to pivot you are among the first early adopters
  • Take a lead in situations that present any obstacle to execution.
  • An insatiable curiosity, and an inability to leave a problem alone until you’ve found one or many different potential solutions.
  • Responsible for the implementation of CTC’s Meta best practices
  • Build campaigns using our structure and best practices
  • Upkeep and management of our ideologies and processes throughout the account.
  • Monitoring active campaigns, and adjusting budgets and strategy to ensure the best possible chance of hitting the Daily Projected Targets
  • Implementing tests in your accounts in an effort to beat your best-performing campaigns.

ENSURING AND HOLDING THE STANDARD OF QUALITY OF WORK

  • Ensuring you are within a 5% Delta to the Forecast
  • Ensuring daily alignment with the client vs the forecast & strategy
  • Ensuring following the Prophet system execution to 100% within the timeline required.
  • Ensuring all the work is delivered based on the timeline assigned with optimal quality & attention to detail.

Client Communication

  • You are a champion of communication, ensuring the client is aligned on the Growth Map goals and next steps, while making sure everybody on your team has clarity on what is required with exact deadlines.
  • Responsible for sending daily performance updates to the client
  • Ensure alignment across Strategy and Forecast with the client for every day of the week.
  • Providing weekly updates on the Weekly Strategy Call.

CONTRIBUTING BACK

  • Contributing your learnings back to the system for feedback and continuous improvement
  • Contributing & collaborating in ideas and learning across teams
  • Contributing to ideas and learning in future company content production.

NEXT-LEVEL SKILLS

Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English, with a proven ability to communicate persuasively and present ideas clearly to various stakeholders.
  • Skilled in crafting thoughtful, empathetic client messaging that resonates, demonstrating a high level of emotional intelligence.
  • Strong presentation skills, capable of delivering compelling presentations that drive engagement and decision-making.
  • Strong raw talent for data analysis, with an eagerness to learn and improve.
  • Familiarity with data tools, including Google Sheets, with the flexibility to develop advanced skills through on-the-job experience.

Past Experience

  • Historical expertise that compounds to bring a well-rounded perspective and adds value to the role.
  • A breadth of experience from any of the multiple domains, including mathematics, data analytics, business operations, retail, finance, media buying, etc

Critical Thinking

  • Ability to approach challenges with structured thinking, utilizing logical frameworks to effectively solve complex problems.
  • Naturally adept at dissecting issues and proposing practical, impactful solutions.

Impact

  • Passionate about e-commerce and eager to contribute to a high-performing team at the forefront of the industry.
  • Highly motivated and hardworking, with a strong desire to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact.
  • Thrives in environments where they can see the direct results of their actions on the business, with a strong preference for roles that offer full accountability and autonomy.

Results

You will merge the Finance and Marketing sides of a business to build a forecasted strategy to help the business achieve its goal.

  • Achieve certification and confidence in our ideology by the end of the kick off, enabling precise execution of the Prophet system to ensure top-quality results for clients.
  • Consistently deliver high-accuracy performance within a 5% delta across the Prophet system’s Growth Map and Statlas.
  • Lead and collaborate with your team to optimize productivity and maintain high-performance standards.
  • Apply best practices in media buying to drive outstanding results, ensuring no one could achieve better outcomes in your role.
  • Maintain client satisfaction levels above benchmark rates, aligning daily on forecasts to exceed client expectations.
  • Adhere to rigorous quality standards in client feedback, forecasting, media buying decisions, and system execution.
  • Meet all deadlines and budget requirements, ensuring timely and on Target Performance.
  • Contribute valuable ideas to team discussions and company-wide content, supporting growth and innovation.

DOMAIN

MANAGEMENT

  • Your supervisor would be Joy Sharma, The Director of the CTC Accelerator Program.
  • You’ll report directly to Joy Sharma —a leader known for his relentless pursuit of excellence and an unmatched passion for growth strategy. Joy is a rare mentor, often described as the closest you’ll come to learning directly from Taylor Holiday himself. With a career built on his own rigorous, self-driven learning, Joy has transformed numerous team members into top-tier strategists, instilling in them the values of dedication, precision, and continuous improvement.

Working under Joy's guidance will push you to your limits in the best possible way. He models the value of hard work, and learning from him feels like “drinking from a firehose”—you’ll absorb knowledge quickly and consistently, experiencing tremendous growth. Joy is committed to personally ensuring you reach your full potential as a Head of Growth Marketing, supporting your journey every step of the way.

ORIENTATION

  • This role will be client-facing.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR ME?

SALARY RANGE

  • First month: $2,000
  • Second month: $4,000
  • Third month (on average): $7,000 a month
  • 1st Year Annual Range: $64,000-$76,000
  • 2nd Year Annual Range: $100,000-$120,000

This will depend on the amount of clients and the quality of work.

Growth, Transparency, and Fairness in Career Development

  • Progress is Clearly Defined
  • Depends primarily on your experience with the system & quality of execution against it. Following a well-defined path for the first 12 months and how exactly you can grow to be promoted to the next level.
  • Fairness and transparency are prioritized
  • Access a weekly performance dashboard to see exactly where you stand compared to team members on both objective and subjective metrics.
  • Pay transparency is upheld for all team members
  • With consistent contract terms and a clear roadmap for increasing earnings, ensuring everyone understands the path to greater compensation. We will also talk monthly about how you can progress.
  • My Commitment to You:
  • You will work harder, learn more than ever before, and “make more than you ever have.” You will gain a diverse skill set while actively contributing to the continuous development of new tools and improvements within our system. In doing so you will have an incredible opportunity for rapid career progression.
  • We will continue to provide you mentorship through every step of your development in the role and promotion from it. We will then continue to provide feedback against the expectation and evaluate against it.
  • Fully remote with the ability to pick your schedule.
  • Embrace autonomy as a core value, with clear expectations, regular 1:1 feedback sessions, and measurable quality benchmarks to support personal growth. Exceptional work is recognized and rewarded, with weekly check-ins for accountability, ensuring you’re consistently challenged and engaged with new opportunities daily.

description:
Sobre a Olist

Na Olist, somos o ecossistema que transforma o varejo brasileiro. Nossa missão é ser a parceira nº 1 do empreendedor, impulsionando seu negócio e sua vida com soluções que integram gestão, vendas, finanças e logística.

Com tecnologia, inovação e um time colaborativo, ajudamos mais de 50 mil lojistas a crescerem de forma competitiva e sustentável. Aqui, construímos juntos o futuro do comércio com conexão, impacto e propósito.

Como Você Vai Fortalecer a Nossa Missão

Seu papel como Gerente de Tecnologia na Olist será essencial para evoluir a plataforma de Ecommerce e os processos da área, além de gerir as equipes, lidar com a manutenção de sistemas legados e o desenvolvimento de novos sistemas.

Esta vaga é remota, em regime CLT, com uma logística de trabalho perfeita para quem mora em qualquer lugar do Brasil.

Suas Principais Responsabilidades

  • Estruturar processos e práticas de desenvolvimento, assegurando qualidade técnica e escalabilidade da plataforma.
  • Dialogar com o time de infraestrutura para evoluir elasticidade, performance e resiliência do ecommerce.
  • Apoiar a transição do monólito para uma arquitetura distribuída, avaliando tecnologias e boas práticas.
  • Conduzir a integração da plataforma de ecommerce ao ecossistema Olist;
  • Liderar e desenvolver o time, garantindo entregas de alto impacto alinhadas à estratégia do negócio.
  • Atuar de forma estratégica junto à liderança, conectando visão técnica e de produto.
  • Acompanhar os indicadores de negócio e de usabilidades dos usuários e relacionar com os indicadores técnicos
  • Estar atento às tendências e inovações do mercado digital, garantindo que a plataforma de ecommerce acompanhe práticas modernas de SEO, integrações estratégicas e avanços em tecnologia e IA.

O Que Buscamos

  • Superior completo em áreas correlatas à tecnologia;
  • Sólida experiência na liderança de times de engenharia e desenvolvimento;
  • Experiência em plataformas de ecommerce ou em ecossistemas com múltiplos produtos integrados.
  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia SaaS ou plataformas digitais.
  • Conhecimento em Ruby/Rails;
  • Familiaridade com Python ou outra linguagem de script;
  • Capacidade de dialogar sobre infraestrutura e arquitetura, orientando decisões junto a outros líderes técnicos.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em Golang e Php, especialmente em cenários de integração com ERP será considerado um diferencial.

Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?

Acreditamos Que Grandes Parcerias Começam Com Boas Conversas. Nosso Processo é Construído Em Etapas Para Que Você Conheça Mais Sobre a Olist e a Gente Conheça Mais Sobre Você

  • Inscrição
  • Entrevista com o time de Gente & Gestão
  • Entrevista técnica
  • Entrevista com pares da área
  • Entrevista final com a liderança

Todas as etapas são realizadas de forma remota. Caso haja necessidade de uma conversa presencial, avisaremos com antecedência.

Benefícios Flexíveis, Do Seu Jeito

Na Olist, acreditamos que cada pessoa tem uma jornada única, e nossos benefícios refletem isso. Porque cuidar dos olisters também é parte da nossa missão.

  • Cartão Caju: liberdade para usar seu saldo em categorias como alimentação, mobilidade, home office, cultura, saúde e educação
  • Plano de Saúde e Plano Odontológico: diferentes opções para que você escolha o cuidado que melhor combina com sua realidade
  • Wellhub e TotalPass: acesso a academias, estúdios e plataformas de bem-estar para cuidar do corpo e da mente do seu jeito
  • Auxílio-creche: apoio no cuidado com a família desde os primeiros passos
